entities.name: Bobby Atwater
entities.description:
Bobby Atwater was a skilled mercenary who worked as head of security aboard Duncan Kincaid's ship, the Essex. He and the rest of the crew were contracted by Martin Krebs to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert and collect DNA samples from the largest prehistoric species there in order to create a cure for heart disease.

Bobby Atwater arrived at Van Dijk's Bar & Grill in Suriname to a swarm of children. He picks one up and playfully turns one of them upside down. After that, he made his way to where Zora Bennett, Duncan Kincaid, and Martin Krebs were already talking. Being in on Zora and Duncan's plan double their pay from Krebs, Bobby feigns not being able to go on the mission. His act was unneeded though, because Krebs had already agreed to doubling it before he showed up. The first creature the team had their sights on was the Mosasaurus. It had been tagged by InGen years ago, and Martin Krebs had the equipment to track its location because his employer Parker-Genix bought InGen's data. Bobby was taking a look at his equipment which included a vial of liquid that he taps with his finger a few times. Henry Loomis questions him about it, and he tells him it's a neurotoxin that paralyzes its victim within seconds. Loomis did not like the implication of Atwater bringing this along, the implication being that he intended to use it on dinosaurs.

The radio aboard the Essex picks up a mayday signal sent by Reuben Delgado. When the team discusses whether to respond to it, Bobby asserts that going to these coordinates would set them back, and they should instead continue tracking the Mosasaurus and get what they need from it before responding to the signal. Krebs approves of his plan, but ultimately, Duncan made the call to respond to the signal immediately.

They eventually reached the family stranded at water on the hull of their overturned boat La Mariposa. Reuben, his daughters Teresa and Isabella, and Teresa's boyfriend Xavier Dobbs were let aboard the Essex.

entities.name: Austin
entities.description:
Austin was an Asset Containment Unit commander at Jurassic World on Isla Nublar during the 2015 Jurassic World Incident.

Along with Katashi Hamada, he and his team were sent to catch the Indominus rex. After the creature ambushed them, killing Hamada, Austin attempted to subdue it with a net launcher, resulting in the death of Lee when the Indominus caused a tree to fall on him and crush him. Austin and a fellow soldier then dragged an injured comrade to safety while Miller covered them by shooting at the creature. He survived the entire ambush and later appeared along with Meyers and a number of park rangers when Main Street was attacked by pterosaurs, helping to subdue the creatures.

Austin carried a CODA All-Purpose Net Gun with the intent of capturing the Indominus rex alive which proved futile as it clawed its way out of it.

The baby Tyrannosaur was an infant Tyrannosaurus rex that lived on Isla Sorna. The female and male Tyrannosaurs were its parents. The baby had its leg broken by Howard King, who stepped on it.

The baby Tyrannosaurus lived in the nest made by its parents on Isla Sorna. The baby had just hatched by the time of the 1995 expedition on the island.

Lewis Dodgson, Howard King, and George Baselton were getting eggs from the nest when they ran into the newly hatched baby. Dodgson yelled at King, who was dazed, to get an egg. King grabbed one, which slipped out of his hands. He caught it again, lurching back. He stepped on the baby's left leg, causing it to scream.

Laura mourns his death in Episode 2, implying she shared a strong bond of friendship with him.

entities.name: George Baselton
entities.description:
Dr. George Baselton, was a heavyset Stanford professor. He was hired by InGen to help keep the Isla Nublar incident a secret. Baselton was later hired by Biosyn in order to help clear controversy surrounding the company.

A popular face on TV concerning wild scientific theories, Baselton was hired by InGen and able to effectively convince people that InGen's cloned dinosaurs were a myth. Later, he was hired by Biosyn, a company known for its legally dubious practices, to fix their image. Considered a celebrity biologist. he was discovered by Richard Levine, when he overheard a telephone conversation between an Unnamed Helicopter Pilot and Baselton. Levine discovered Baselton was looking for the "island". The professor accompanied Lewis Dodgson and Dr. Howard King to Site B and planned to later write a report presenting their findings to the world.

As the trio of Dodgson, King, and Baselton went around stealing eggs from nests, they reached the Tyrannosaurus nest. Baselton revealed that he read that a T. rex may have vision that was based around movement, which was his eventual downfall. This controversial theory was produced by John Roxton. He lost his nerve in the rex's nest, prompting Dodgson to try and grab an egg in Baselton's place. This caused Dodgson's sound machine to lose its power as it chord was yanked away. In the resulting silence, Baselton was eaten alive by one of the Tyrannosaurs, starting with his arm. Baselton wore a gold Rolex watch on his arm that got torn off.

Baselton did not appear in the film. Instead, he is replaced by the character of Robert Burke. Like Baselton, Burke was also a scientist who was hired by the rogue team, and he was also eaten by a Tyrannosaurus rex. However, Burke is considered to be far more sympathetic, as Burke was a neutral character and Baselton was an active antagonist.

entities.name: LaDonna Belvedere
entities.description:
Dr. LaDonna Belvedere was a scientist who was indirectly hired by Biosyn. She studied animals in their habitats. She is featured in the Jurassic Park: Raptors Hijack comic series.

Dr. Belvedere was funded by Biosyn before the events of the comic series. She released a gorilla into unfamiliar surroundings, which was the Colombian jungle to promote her study of animals in their habitats. Later on, she found two Velociraptors named Alf and Celia which previously fought the animal. As she observed them, Dr. Belvedere exhibited the same body language as the raptors. This leads to her being accepted by the raptors. She was confronted by Dr. Jeremiah Fischer (who was hired by CEO Bill Steingarten to get hold of the raptors) from the United States Army, who proposes starting a Biosyn version of Jurassic Park. She reluctantly accepts the role of head-keeper to support the raptor population. Dr. Belvedere continues to note the behaviour of the raptors albeit with immense remorse for their captivity. When Drs. Ellie Sattler and Ian Malcolm found out about the park, they break the raptors free, which end up killing several Biosyn officers and Dr. Fischer. Alf and Celia maul Dr. Belvedere to death despite her own signs of friendship.

entities.name: Zora Bennett
entities.description:
Zora Bennett is a skilled covert operations expert and the main lead protagonist in . She is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs until her operation intersects with a civilian family.

Zora Bennett appears as a professional, strongly focused on the mission. However, she has also a strong sense of humor. She has close relations with her team especially with Duncan, as they understand each other's trauma. She still feels the grief of her friend's death. She seems to be primarily concentrated on her job and not in her private life. Despite working as a mercenary and ready to break certain rules, she does have a grew a conscience as she helps the Delgados despite the mission and even rejects the money by sharing the discovery with everyone. She shares a bond with Henry Loomis possibly over a shared sense of adventure.

Zora was a mercenary, with a background in MARSOC, that worked primarily worked in war-torn areas. Her and Booker were in a car in Yemen when a car bomb blew up. Booker slowly died. This memory has continued to hurt Zora, because Booker was a good friend of hers.

In the summer of 2027, Zora encountered Martin Krebs in New York. Whilst in traffic Bennett was able to sneak into Krebs’ car. The two talked about an upcoming mission that Krebs and his employer Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering had recruited Bennett for. Zora mentioned that they were meant to meet at another location. Bennett also said that Krebs wasn’t hard to follow. Eventually, Zora exited the vehicle and Krebs followed her after parking the car. They talked about a mission to Ile Saint-Hubert, a former InGen island. Krebs mentioned that the mission isn’t legal and they could face criminal prosecution. Martin said that a civilian is on the mission, although the civilian doesn’t know this yet. Krebs also mentions that Zora would be paid a high amount of money for the mission.

entities.name: Arby Benton
entities.description:
R.B. "Arby" Benton was an African-American seventh-grade student at Woodside Junior High and best and only friend of Kelly Curtis and only appeared in .

He was a seventh grader, only eleven years-old, having skipped two grades because he was a child prodigy and particularly extremely skilled with computers. Both of his parents were doctors in San Jose, California, and Arby was accustomed to a well-to-do lifestyle, dressed in formal clothes in school with had good, reliable parents. His mother was a gynecologist and very kind. Both Arby and Kelly worked odd jobs for Richard Levine, who was working as their teacher as part of his court order. Arby later discovered the hidden files on Levine's computer, and thus helped Doctors Ian Malcolm and Jack Thorne to discover the location of Site B. Originally, both he and Kelly were allowed and prepared to go on a field trip during school break to test out a large range of equipment that Levine had ordered from Doc Thorne. However, they were disappointed to find that the testing session was cancelled.

Not wanting to be left out of finding Levine, both kids stowed away in the field trailers that were destined for Isla Sorna by concealing themselves in bundles of blankets. Arby managed to get into the Local Area Network and was amazed to see live dinosaurs. Once found by the adults, Arby first acted to save them from an adult Tyrannosaurus. Later, during a raptor attack on the High Hide, Arby fell out and sought refuge in the predator protection cage. The raptors nevertheless brought him to the nest, injuring him, until he was rescued by Levine and Thorne. He later escaped the island on a boat with the rest of the survivors.

His character did not appear in the film The Lost World: Jurassic Park. Instead, his character and Kelly's were combined into Ian Malcolm's daughter Kelly Malcolm. Later on, his character was adapted into Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom as Franklin Webb and Camp Cretaceous as Darius Bowman.

entities.name: Berner
entities.description:
He was working at the InGen Waterfront Complex during Peter Ludlow's speech to an audience of reporteres and investors while awaiting the arrival of the Venture. After the Venture smashed into the pier, he found a dazed Ludlow and helped him to his feet. He was then among the several guards who accompanied Ludlow, Ian Malcolm and Sarah Harding aboard the crashed ship to determine what had happened. Entering the ship's wheelhouse, he reacted with disgust. Ludlow, unaware of what was awaiting him, entered behind Berner and asked where the crew were. "All over the place," Berner responded, and Ludlow finally noticed the gruesome remains of the sailors. It is unknown what happened to Berner after his fellow guard Jerry Randall unwittingly unleashed the captured male Tyrannosaurus rex, although he presumably escaped.

entities.name: Bertie
entities.description:
Bertie was from the African nation of South Africa. She is dark skinned and has black curly hair. After experience working with wildlife she was hired by Simon Masrani to work as the head animal trainer at his park, Jurassic World. In this job she led other employees in the management and wellbeing of the dinosaurs that lived in the park. She and a team of twelve normally worked with young herbivores, helping them integrate into the habitats after they hatched. Bertie was also in charge of feeding Rexy, the resident Tyrannosaurus rex who came from Jurassic Park. These feedings happened on Thursdays while most of the carnivore caretakers were on Isla Sorna.

While Bertie was the head trainer in 2004, it is unknown if she remained in that position 11 year later by the events of the 2015 Isla Nublar Incident.

entities.name: Janet Best
entities.description:
Janet Best is a main character in the interactive audio game Jurassic World Revealed. She is a journalist and the host of the podcast Frankly Best, dedicated to uncovering truths and reporting them to the public. She is known to be a terrible liar and an expert swimmer. She also has knowledge of Ian Malcolm's book "God Creates Dinosaurs", but it is unknown if she possesses it or not.

Janet is dedicated deeply to her podcast and wants nothing more than the public to know what Frankly Best has to tell them. However, at some points, she considers the fact that she may be going too far to draw attention to her podcast. While describing the state of the derelict Main Street into her recorder in great detail, she pauses to ask Jessie if her words are too over-the-top.

In 2018, Janet and her executive producer Jessie (the player) travel to Isla Nublar to report on the fate of the dinosaurs before the eruption of Mt. Sibo. During this, they accidentally uncover the secret agenda of Eli Mills and Ken Wheatley to betray the Dinosaur Protection Group and take the dinosaurs for their own purposes. After escaping Isla Nublar aboard the Arcadia in disguise, Janet vows to expose the plot to the public by any means necessary. Her fate is unknown following the ship's docking near Lockwood Manor.

Throughout the adventure, Janet relies on Jessie to get them through most decisions. Their actions are determined by the player's choices via voice command.

entities.name: Big Eatie
entities.description:
Big Eatie is a female Tyrannosaurus rex and a major character in the fourth and fifth seasons of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. She later returned in the first season of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory as a minor character.

Big Eatie is a female Tyrannosaurus with bluish grey skin, unlike other T. rex seen previously. Big Eatie also sports old scars of unknown origins, most likely from her and Little Eatie's previous play-fights, and gained fresh new scars from her and her daughter's fight as a result of Mantah Corp tampering with the meat they were eating; but by the start of Season 5, these scars were now healed.

In Episode 3, Big Eatie was observed by the campers engaging in a meal with her daughter, Little Eatie. Dr. Mae Turner informed the campers that Big Eatie consistently allowed Little Eatie to eat the meat first, indicating her nurturing nature as a mother. Similar to other Tyrannosaurus depicted in the movie canon, Big Eatie displayed a tendency towards aggression and hostility when provoked, as evidenced by several instances.

However, in Seasons 4 and 5, Big Eatie demonstrated a higher level of intelligence than previously believed. She exhibited the capacity to remember Darius after he removed a tail spike from her leg, and she recalled his actions when he freed her from the mind-controlling chips. There was a brief moment where Big Eatie made eye contact with Darius before walking away, indicating a recognition of his actions.

entities.name: Big Momma
entities.description:
Big Momma was one of the many dinosaurs cloned by InGen that became wild on Isla Sorna after the events of Hurricane Clarissa. By 2001, she was full grown and had become the leader of her herd.

During Eric's stay on the island, during her search for food, Big Momma woke Eric up when her head crashed through the leaves of the tree the boy had been sleeping in. Startled by the sauropod's sudden appearance, Eric fell out of the tree, sliding down the back of the Diplodocus and landing in some of her dung. As three more Diplodocus joined their leader, Eric identified the sauropod's species and gave her the name "Big Momma". Afterwards, he left the herd to continue his life on the island. entities.name: The Big One
entities.description:
The Big One (nicknamed by Robert Muldoon) was the alpha female of the Velociraptors and the main antagonist of the original Jurassic Park film. Though her name may suggest that she is the largest raptor in her pack, there is no evidence that Stan Winston Studio nor Industrial Light and Magic made one of the raptors in larger or with unique physical traits than the others and evidence points toward her being physically identical to the other raptors in her pack. Her name may just be a reference to the fact that she is the leader of her pack or in other words the "big one in charge".

All Velociraptors, including the Big One, were initially bred on Site B, particularly a compound owned and operated by InGen. Eight raptors were transported to Isla Nublar, the site of InGen's upcoming Jurassic Park theme resort.

When the Big One came in she took over the pride and killed all but two of the other raptors. She commanded her two remaining subordinates to attack the security fencing. Muldoon claimed that in comparison to the other raptors, the Big One had an extremely high problem-solving intelligence, remembering the location of certain weak spots in the fencing and where feeders would come to feed the animals as stated.

As a result, the raptors had to be transported into a special holding pen to be fed by an automated feeding system to make sure they stayed in.

entities.description:
After Dennis Nedry failed to show up at the East Dock with the Barbasol can full of dinosaur embryos, this operative was dispatched by Lewis Dodgson to meet Miles Chadwick and Nima Cruz at the North Dock with a boat. There, the operative would give the two their payment and deliver them off of the island.

However, by the time that Nima arrived at the dock with Gerry and Jessica Harding, there was no sign of the operative, just their boat. The three presumed that the operative had either been eaten by a dinosaur or killed by Billy Yoder who was also seeking to use the boat to escape and claim the money for selling the embryos to Biosyn. The Hardings and Nima used the boat to escape from the island and Jess found Nima's payment hidden in a locker on the boat.

entities.name: Blaze
entities.description:
Blaze is a young female Atrociraptor that first appeared in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. She was one of the seven Atrociraptors created for Project Theropod Axis by Biosyn in their Sanctuary.

Blaze shares the same skin pattern as Red, with the sole exception of her color. She is grey, with cream underbelly and has grey stripes running down from the tip of her head to her hips. She has orange-yellow eyes.

Blaze is first seen when she and Princess were placed in a maze for training. They received the order of reaching a Compsognathus and then Blaze starts trying to reach it by running through the Maze. But before she could reach the target, Princess beat her and tackles the Compsognathus. When the two raptors were ordered to fight each other, Princess stood in an assertive, dominant position and becomes Blaze’s alpha. The two then work together to break free from the laser control system and kill Dr. Munnlerynn and Dr. Samuelson with the help of their pack.

Blaze attacked Rexy with her pack. She was winning until the Buck and Doe appeared, which attacked and fended the pack off.

Blender was first mentioned by Sammy when Bumpy laid the egg. She also mentions that Bumpy would sometimes run off from the ranch to meet him.

Blender protects Smoothie from getting stepped on by a Monolophosaurus, meeting him for the first time and recognizing him as his son before reuniting with Bumpy, also recognizing her.

Blender is seen happily living with Bumpy and Smoothie in Biosyn Valley after the incident.

entities.description:
Blonde (sometimes referred to as Blondie) is a female Becklespinax seen in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory season one. Blonde is the second Becklespinax seen in the show, her twin sister is nicknamed Brunette. The Becklespinax twins’ names were confirmed via Jurassic World: The Game in a seasonal event.

Blonde is a Becklespinax. Like many of the cloned theropods, she has pronated wrists. She also has large white spines sticking out from the back of her neck, and a small sail on her back. Her body color is mostly olive green with a red face, a yellow neck, and black markings.

Blonde is shown to be more aggressive than Brunette. She often showed hostility toward humans.

Corrupt DPW officials Jared and Jensen released Blonde into the Park County dinosaur free zone. She went on a rampage and killed several people. Ben Pincus and Yasmina Fadoula drove off in Ben's van and Blonde chased after it. When they got to the bridge, the friends had to fend her off long enough for Sammy Gutierrez to get into the van. Blonde is further agitated when Jared and Jensen start firing darts in her direction, causing her to ram the van off of the bridge and fall off into the lake along with it.

entities.description:
Boss is a male Carnotaurus who appeared in , , and as a minor antagonist.

He can easily be recognized by his distinct broken horn and three big scars across the left side of his face. He also has a different color scheme than other Carnotaurus individuals instead of having a brownish red color he has a reddish charcoal color across his body and red on his face with more pointy spikes down his back than others making it easy to mistake him for Toro the other male Carnotaurus.

In , Boss is depicted with Toro's model before it was burned with its broken horn, however his scars are absent, making it inconsistent with the live-action appearances of the dinosaur.

Not much is known about Boss’ background except he was present on Isla Nublar during the time before and after the Jurassic World Incident until the eruption of the island’s volcano Mount Sibo.

Cathy Bowman is a little girl who appeared in .

Cathy Bowman was the excited young girl who explored the beach on Isla Sorna. She was portrayed as a British girl coming from a wealthy family that was vacationing on a yacht cruise. As she wandered throughout the beach, she came upon a Compsognathus. When she went to feed the Compsognathus a little piece of her food, the others suddenly came out from the grass, had surrounded and had attacked her. Her parents, Paul and Deirdre Bowman, and the crew of their yacht heard her screams and ran to her aid. It was revealed by John Hammond that Cathy had survived the attack. During a InGen's boarding meeting, the pictures of the incident were shown, and her parents were described as "wealthy, angry, and litigious", hinting at a possible lawsuit against InGen.

entities.name: Darius Bowman
entities.description:
Darius Bowman, often called "D" and affectionately nicknamed "Dino-Nerd", is the main protagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous and its sequel series Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

In winter of 2015, he came to Isla Nublar after winning the opportunity to participate in Jurassic World's Camp Cretaceous after beating the Jurassic World VR video game. During his time on the island, he becomes the elected leader of the Nublar Six and later ends up becoming the adoptive brother of Kenji Kon. He was 12 (later 13) years old during the events of Camp Cretaceous and is 19 years old during the events of Chaos Theory. He is voiced by Paul-Mikél Williams.

Darius was born sometime in 2003. He is the second son of Fredrick and Mrs. Bowman, as well as the younger brother of Brandon Bowman.

Having grown up in a world where previously extinct dinosaurs lived and breathed, Darius developed a deep interest and admiration for these magnificent beings. This fascination was shared with his father (who most likely also influenced him), which made them have a fairly close relationship. Among other things, they enjoyed reading articles related to research and paleontological findings, especially those related to the doctor of paleontology Alan Grant. But the true dream of Darius and his father was to visit the Jurassic World theme park on Isla Nublar. They promised each other to visit the park and exchanged gifts to indicate their intention to do so.

entities.name: Deirdre Bowman
entities.description:
Deirdre Bowman is the overprotective mother of Cathy Bowman and the wife of Paul Bowman.

Deirdre first appeared at the very beginning of the picnicking on a beach with both her husband and daughter, Paul and Cathy Bowman. Deirdre wouldn't allow her own daughter to play and have fun on the beach, due to having an irrational fear of snakes. When Cathy was attacked by a pack of Compsognathus, Deirdre screaming in horror just; before the scene cuts away. They sued InGen for Cathy's attack which led to John Hammond being removed as CEO from the company and his nephew Peter Ludlow became CEO. Deirdre and her family is not seen in the rest of the movie; but John Hammond mention that; Cathy had survived the attack.

Deirdre appears to be based on Ellen Bowman, the mother of Tina Bowman, a character from the Jurassic Park novel.

Deirdre Bowman appears as a playable character in LEGO Jurassic World. In the game's retelling of the events of the second film, her daughter's encounter with the Compsognathus is absent and instead the Bowman Family's visit to Isla Sorna is depicted in two still photographs in Hammond's room when Hammond is talking to Ian Malcolm about the incident. In the first photo, Deirdre is sunbathing on their yacht and watches as her daughter catches an octopus with a fishing pole. The second photo depicts Deirdre Bowman with her family feeding a T. rex a hot dog despite a nearby "Do Not Feed" sign.

entities.name: Ellen Bowman
entities.description:
Ellen Bowman was 30 years old in 1989, meaning that she was probably born sometime around 1959. She is described as being very slim and beautiful, yet she is always obsessing over her looks. For example; she often complains about how she thinks that she needs to lose weight, even though her husband often reassures her and, in fact, thinks that she is too skinny. She wouldn't let her own daughter run off and play, due to an irrational fear of snakes. However, after Tina was bitten by a Procompsognathus and taken to a hospital in Costa Rica, Ellen is very worried about her daughter.

However, Martin "Marty" Guitierrez, a local lizard expert, assures her that Tina has suffered from a severe allergic reaction to the bite of a common Basiliscus amoratus, and nothing more severe. Then, along with Mike Bowman, she takes Tina back home.

entities.name: Fredrick Bowman
entities.description:
Fredrick Bowman was the posthumous overarching protagonist of the Netflix series, Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous.

Fredrick was the father of Darius Bowman and Brandon Bowman, the husband of Mrs. Bowman and the posthumous adoptive father of Kenji Kon. Fredrick had a keen interest in dinosaurs like his youngest son.

Fredrick was Darius's father, and a fellow dinosaur enthusiast. He planned a trip with Darius to Jurassic World sometime in the past, but got sick and had died soon after. Before his death, he gave his son, Darius a Velociraptor tooth necklace, to match the one he got for himself.

In season 2, Frederick was seen in Darius's nightmare.

entities.name: Mike Bowman
entities.description:
Michael "Mike" Bowman was a 36 year-old real estate developer from Dallas, Texas. He was married to Ellen Bowman, and was the father of Christina, their only child.

Bowman and his wife had planned a trip to Costa Rica for months, but Mike discovered all the planning was merely a cover-up for his wife to meet with a plastic surgeon in San Jose. After a fight, their two-week holiday got back on track, and they went to a deserted beach in Cabo Blanco. His daughter went off to explore, and was attacked by a small green lizard.

Mike and Ellen raced Tina to the hospital in Puntaranes, where she recovered and was discharged the following morning.

entities.name: Tina Bowman
entities.description:
Christina L. "Tina" Bowman was the daughter of Mike Bowman and Ellen Bowman in Jurassic Park. She was attacked by a Procompsognathus.

In 1989, Tina's parents took her on a vacation to the Cabo Blanco Biological Preserve in Costa Rica. They eventually found a beach, and settled down. Tina began searching for animals to catalogue for her school project. She came across a strange bipedal lizard, and tried to interact with it. However, it then attacked her, causing severe injuries. Her parents then drove her to a hospital. After she had recovered, she drew a picture of the lizard that had attacked her, and gave it to Dr. Marty Guitierrez for identification.

It was eventually revealed that the lizard which had attacked her was actually a Procompsognathus that had been cloned by InGen, and had escaped from Isla Nublar.

Tina did not appear in the first film, as the entire subplot of dinosaurs escaping to the mainland and attacking children was written out of the film.

The three siblings are Alf, Betty, and Celia, and the Tssr and Br are their already deceased brothers.

Several days after the incident at Jurassic Park, Alan Grant, and Ellie Sattler our brought back to Isla Nublar as animal consultants as the military tries to find and round up the remaining dinosaurs. After a successful capture of the tyrannosaur, there is a discussion as to whether there are still Raptors remaining out in the park. The military believed that all animals were killed while Grant and Ellie believes that they perhaps have a nest hidden off somewhere.

A poacher by the name of George Lawalla, follows the two into a cave, where a mother raptor and five chicks (three male and two female) have nestled. entities.name: The Brachiosaurus
entities.description:
The Brachiosaurus was the first dinosaur encountered by the endorsement team hired by InGen to make sure Jurassic Park was safe for visitors. The entire team was astonished. Doctors Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler were the most awestruck of the group because the Brachiosaurus was terrestrial, not semi-aquatic swamp dwellers like they had thought they were.

When Mt. Sibo erupts, this individual, the same one seen by Grant and Sattler 25 years ago, made it to the island's northern dock and began desperately crying out and standing on her hind legs as she was slowly engulfed by the volcano's toxic smoke and debris, watched by an emotional Claire Dearing and Owen Grady in the Arcadia as it closes.

entities.name: Erica Brand
entities.description:
Erica Brand was a representative of Verizon who wanted to sponsor an attraction at the dinosaur theme-park Jurassic World.

She was described by Claire Dearing as "deserves better". Erica, along with fellow representatives Hal Osterly and Jim Drucker, was received at Jurassic World by senior park employee Claire Dearing, who gave them a pitch on the status of the park as she led them through the labs in the Innovation Center. Of the three, Erica remained silent, though she showed assent with Hal Osterly's demand for a thrilling dinosaur. She listened with interest to Henry Wu's description of the Indominus rex and apparently agreed to sponsor the animal. She doesn't appear again in the film afterwards.

entities.name: Artie Bridges
entities.description:
Artie Bridges was the manager of the janitorial group for Jurassic Park. He also hosted a quasi-radio station via the park's intercom.

Artie managed the janitorial group on Isla Nublar but was acquainted with Dr. Laura Sorkin who showed him how to hack into the park's intercom to play pre-recorded "radio" broadcasts after he begged her and told her that it was his dream to be a radio star. Most other employees considered his broadcasts to be terrible, however.

Just before the 1993 Isla Nublar Incident, Artie had queued up one of his pre-recorded broadcasts to remind people about the storm evacuation before leaving for the East Dock himself. When InGen mercenary Billy Yoder was trying to restore power to the park's maintenance tunnels, he accidentally caused Artie's broadcast to play over the intercom.

entities.name: Brooklynn
entities.description:
Brooklynn, often called "B" and affectionately nicknamed "Superstar" is the tritagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous and the overarching protagonist of its sequel series Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. She was 13 years old during the events of Camp Cretaceous and is 20 years old during the events of Chaos Theory. She became Kenji Kon's girlfriend in the first series but the two broke up sometime before the events of Chaos Theory. In Camp Cretaceous, she was voiced by Jenna Ortega, and in Chaos Theory, she is voiced by Kiersten Kelly.

She was presumed dead in Chaos Theory, supposedly dying to the One-Eyed Allosaurus. However, at the end of Season 1, it is revealed that she is alive, but lost her left forearm to the Atrociraptor Ghost, has cut most of her hair, and went into hiding under the name Sydney.

Brooklynn later pretended to be an an ally of Soyona Santos, in order to find a way to bring down her illegal dinosaur trade, which forced her to reject the opportunity to return to her friends side in the end of Season 2 to keep them safe from Santos. But this temporarily cost her Sammy Gutierrez's and Kenji Kon's trust. But after Santos' arrest, Brooklynn returned to her friends' side at the end of Season 3 and made amends with them by the end of Season 4.

Brooklynn is likely American; due to her accent. But she used to live in London, capital of the United Kingdom with her fathers. She learned how to fix radios and cars and other things like that with her fathers. At some point in her life, although possibly during the time she was ten, Brooklynn became a vlogger, traveling the world and gaining sponsors to make interesting videos and her followers are known as "Brooklanders" which also includes Sammy Gutierrez. As a student, Brooklynn never went to high school and was taught exclusively by online tutors. Before going to Isla Nublar, Brooklynn had had already been on various adventures, such as climbing Mount Everest, and diving with hammerhead sharks, one of which she said she hit one in Hawaii, possibly to avoid getting bitten by it.

entities.description:
Jophery Brown was the gatekeeper of Jurassic Park's holding pen for the Velociraptor. His death lead the main investors of InGen to question the safety of the park. He only appears in the opening scene of the movie.

Jophery's character is loosely based on the unnamed Jurassic Park Maintenance Worker, who appears in the prologue of the first novel. He was severely injured by a Velociraptor. Ed Regis brought him to a local hospital in Costa Rica. Doctor Bobby Carter tries to treat the boy. Ed lied and said he'd been injured in a maintenance accident, but Carter knew this was a lie due to him having claw marks and flesh wounds. His last word is "...raptor..."

Jophery, like many other workers, was a security guard for Jurassic Park.

He was the gatekeeper of the Raptor Pen, which was a temporary replacement for the Velociraptor Paddock, because the alpha-female had killed all but two of her subordinates and was attacking the fences.

Bruce is an English language name that arrived in Scotland with the Normans, from the place name Brix, Manche in Normandy, France, meaning "the willowlands". Initially promulgated via the descendants of king Robert the Bruce (1274−1329), it has been a Scottish surname since medieval times; it is now a common male given name.

The variant Lebrix and Le Brix are French variations of the surname.

entities.description:
Brunette is a Becklespinax featured in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory season one. She is the first Becklespinax seen in the show, followed by her twin sister, nicknamed Blonde. The Becklespinax twins’ names were confirmed via Jurassic World: The Game in a seasonal event.

Brunette has dark brown spikes on her neck and head. Her skin coloration is composed an orangish brown on her neck, a darker brown on her head, legs, and spine, and tail, and a lighter brown on the middle areas of her body. Her underside is a tan color that is lighter than the rest of her body. She has orange eyes.

Brunette seems to be less aggressive than Blonde and observes a bit more before reacting to what happens around her. This is exhibited when she approaches the Ben's van slowly while Blonde ran at it and repeatedly rammed into it, and when she did not immediately attack when tranquilizer darts were shot in her direction, but instead took the time to see where they were going. She is also shown to be a heavy sleeper.

Corrupt DPW officials Jared and Jensen released Brunette from a DPW transport truck at the unlocked gate to the bridge leading to the Park County dinosaur free zone. Due to Brunette's less aggressive nature, she didn't attack the van but worked as an effective block to keep Ben Pincus, Yasmina Fadoula, and Sammy Gutierrez on the bridge while Blonde pushed them and herself off of it into the lake.

entities.name: Bumpy
entities.description:
Bumpy possesses a dull yellow hue, accompanied by greenish-blue markings on her armor and upper legs, setting her apart from fully grown Ankylosaurus, which typically exhibit a dull gray coloration. Despite her young age, Bumpy's size is comparable to that of a large dog. Her body is adorned with dull osteoderms evenly distributed, and she possesses a short, stubby tail with a club at the end. Notably, due to her premature birth, the spikes on the back of her head are asymmetrical, with the right spike being larger and less blunt than its counterpart on the left.

Within less then two months, Bumpy experiences significant growth and reaches near-full size as she adolescent size, albeit slightly smaller than other individuals of her species. Her predominantly greenish-blue complexion is complemented by a dull yellow shade on her underbelly and lower legs.

Despite being much larger than her human companions, Bumpy is significantly smaller than other Anklyosaurus due to her shortened incubation period. This was shown in Chaos Theory, as Bumpy was significantly smaller than her mate.

As an infant, Bumpy formed a bond with Ben, considering him to be her "father" since he was the first living being she encountered. As Bumpy grew, she alternated between her herd and her adopted parent, seeking protection from the presence of the Indominus rex.

Dr. Robert Burke was a paleontologist hired; by Peter Ludlow to be the team's resident dinosaur expert.

Robert Burke appears as a playable character in LEGO Jurassic World. Like the film, he is eaten by the Tyrannosaurus rex (though offscreen) after being frightened by a snake. However, as Ian, Kelly, Sarah, and Nick leave the island via helicopter they witness the captured Tyrannosaur Buck regurgitating Burke and the other hunters it had eaten alive and well. Thus Burke survives the events of the game as do most of the characters who originally died in the films. Burke has two abilities common among Paleontologists characters in the game, Dig and Bone Build. He can use the Dig ability to dig through stud piles to unearth various objects and/or collectibles. Bone Build allows him to reconstruct bone piles to create various objects or animal skeletons. He is unlocked after The Hunted chapter (Attack of the Camp and The Long Grass) is completed. When the player rescues Dieter Stark from Compys, he calls Burke an idiot for saying that they weren't dangerous.

entities.name: Butler
entities.description:
A butler is a person who works in a house serving and is a domestic worker in a large household. In great houses, the household is sometimes divided into departments, with the butler in charge of the dining room, wine cellar, and pantry. Some also have charge of the entire parlour floor and housekeepers caring for the entire house and its appearance. A butler is usually male and in charge of male servants, while a housekeeper is usually female and in charge of female servants. Traditionally, male servants (such as footmen) were better paid and of higher status than female servants. The butler, as the senior male servant, has the highest servant status. He can also sometimes function as a chauffeur.

In older houses where the butler is the most senior worker, titles such as majordomo, butler administrator, house manager, manservant, staff manager, chief of staff, staff captain, estate manager, and head of household staff are sometimes given. The precise duties of the employee will vary to some extent in line with the title given but, perhaps more importantly, in line with the requirements of the individual employer. In the grandest homes or when the employer owns more than one residence, there is sometimes an estate manager of higher rank than the butler. The butler can also be assisted by a head footman or footboy called the under-butler.

entities.description:
Carl was a minor character appearing in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

Carl is shown to have a big hatred for dinosaurs, especially Bumpy. This can be seen when Carl says that he will be happy when Bumpy is dead.

Carl is first seen driving his truck when he tries to kill Bumpy by running her over. This causes Bumpy to fight back, before Sammy intervenes and protects Carl. Carl then goes on a dinosaur hating rant, before driving away. Later, an Atrociraptor pack came to hunt down the campers. The Atrociraptors kill Carl, before hunting down the others. Darius and Ben find Carl's corpse inside of his truck.

entities.name: Carlos
entities.description:
Carlos is the captain of the Mar Del Plata in who took Ian Malcolm and his team to Isla Sorna.

He refused to accompany them to the interior because he feared "The Five Deaths" and heard too many stories about fishermen who came close to the island and never returned. He was the father of Higo, seen at his side. He only spoke Spanish, so Nick Van Owen translated what he was saying in Spanish to Ian Malcolm in English. He had a radio and satellite phone and would show up in two hours, if the group called, but he would not stay near the islands.

Malcolm tried to call him on the radio on his team's trailer, but it didn't work out.

Carlos appears as an unlockable character in LEGO Jurassic World. After completing the level Isla Sorna, Carlos becomes available for purchase for 40,000 LEGO studs.

entities.description:
Carlos was the co-pilot of the plane in Jurassic World: Aftermath. The pilot was Juan.

Carlos' status is unknown, but it is likely that, he was fatally wounded in the crash caused, by a Pteranodon attack.

Carlos also had pushed Amelia Everett off the plane just, before the crash so that, she could parachute to safety.

Juan seemed to be speaking Spanish just, before they crashed, shouting instructions. After the crash, Juan had called for Carlos and got no reply, before calling for Sam, When Sam had explored the N.M.S Genetics Centre's Corporate section, he comes across Carlos's parachute near a Pteranodon nest.

Maisie disembarks from the jet and states she doesn't want to walk towards Soyona Santos' car, but O'Hara tells her it's not a choice.

entities.name: Eddie Carr
entities.description:
Edward "Eddie" Carr was a field equipment expert sent to Isla Sorna by John Hammond as part of his research team.

In , Eddie Carr designed and provided most of the equipment and vehicles used by the InGen Hunters. Eddie only felt contempt for Dr. Ian Malcolm's attitude toward technology, disliking his rough treatment of their equipment. Despite his meek, slow appearance, Eddie was quite intelligent and knew a little about weaponry as well. He brought along a Lindstradt air rifle, loaded with a fast-acting, deadly neurotoxin, to use if necessary. He also brought along a treehouse like structure called a "high hide", which was designed to act as a lookout for the researchers.

When Ian Malcolm, Sarah Harding, and Nick Van Owen were attacked by two Tyrannosaurus rex in the Fleetwood RV Mobile Lab, Eddie leaped heroically into action. He attached the cable winch of his Mercedes M-Class to the bumper of the trailer, trying to keep it held steady and from going over the cliff long enough for them to climb out and get to safety. This action meant he went into reverse and floored the pedal and ultimately destroyed the car.

Unfortunately, this activity caught the interest of the two Tyrannosaurs, who reappear from the jungle behind him, much to his horror.

entities.name: Carter
entities.description:
Carter was accidentally killed by the female Tyrannosaurus when the team had found themselves pursued through a ravine by the dinosaur.

Following the team's arrival on Isla Sorna, Carter took part in the mission to capture the herbivore dinosaurs on one of the island's game trails. Carter drove a modified jeep with his friend Dieter Stark in the passenger seat. The two were then ordered by their leader Roland Tembo to take down a Pachycephalosaurus. Carter proceeded to move Stark out into the jeep's extendable seat, where he tranquilized the creature.

When the team stopped to rest during their trek to the worker village where they could call for help, Carter decided to listen to music through his portable MP3 player whilst eating nachos. During this time, Stark informed Carter that he was leaving the immediate area so he could relieve himself, failing to notice Carter's headphones. Unfortunately, this meant that Carter couldn't hear Stark's cries for help when he had gotten himself lost in the jungle before being attacked by a pack of Compsognathus, leading to his demise. When the resting time ended, Carter was still listening to his music, forcing a colleague to throw a stone at him to get his attention. While leaving with the group, he failed to notice Stark's backpack just beside him.

After being questioned by Tembo regarding Stark's whereabouts, Carter informed him that he last saw him "ten-fifteen minutes" ago. Tembo subsequently ordered Carter to help him locate Stark. They eventually located the man's remains and headed back to camp. Carter soon fell asleep upon arrival along with the others.

entities.name: Bobby Carter
entities.description:
Roberta "Bobby" Carter worked at a clinic building in the fishing village Bahía Anasco as a first aid employer at the beginning of the events of Jurassic Park.

Bobby studied two years at the in Chicago. After that she went to work two months at the small hospital in the village Bahía Anasco. Her assistant was the skilled Manuel Aragón. When three weeks passed, Ed Regis unexpectedly brought an injured worker to the hospital. Ed Regis claimed that the boy was injured during a construction accident, but Bobby determined from the wounds that the boy was mauled by a wild animal. After Bobby thew Ed out of the room, she took photographs of the wounds. The boy muttered, what sounded to Bobby, like lo sa raptor before his death. She did not know that the boy actually meant Velociraptor. Manuel seemed to think that the boy meant a , faceless vampires that steal away children, and he would have nothing to do with the boy from then on. When the helicopter that had brought Regis and the boy departed, she discovered that the camera, with which she photographed the wounds, had been stolen.

Even after the helicopter had gone, Bobby still wondered what a 'raptor' was. She asked the another employee, Elena Morales, what the word meant, because she thought that it was a Spanish word. But Elena's guesses made no sense to her. When Bobby looked up 'raptor' in the English dictionary she got another definition entirely: "raptor \ n [deriv. of L. raptor plunderer, fr. Raptus]: bird of prey."

entities.description:
Gabriel Cazares is the leader of a Nicarugan drug cartel that appears in Jurassic Park: Dangerous Games. He is a drug lord being tracked down by Daniel Espinoza.

Cazares purchases Isla Nublar, the island where the abandoned Jurassic park resided and where many dinosaurs run rampant. Meanwhile, Daniel Espinoza attempts to try and expose Cazares’s doings, but that only exposes Espinoza’s identity, and Cazares’s men captures him and throws him into the jungle, with Cazares stating that he has 24 hours to survive on the island before Cazares’s thugs hunt him down to kill him.

entities.description:
Cera was one of three female Triceratops that could be encountered at the Triceratops Encounter attraction at Universal's Islands of Adventure in Orlando, Florida alongside her sisters Topper and Chris.

Guests could meet Cera at the Triceratops Encounter where they could take photos of the dinosaur and interact with it. Sometimes baby Triceratops twins Sierra and Sahara would also be featured in the attraction.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w_Lhagjc_wc

entities.name: The Cerato
entities.description:
The Cerato is a Ceratosaurus individual featured in Jurassic Park III. It went up to the group of survivors. Realizing that it was in Spinosaurus territory, it was driven away and emerged back into the forest.

The Cerato is shown to have a red upper body and head, and a light tan lower body. It has black stripes running down from the neck to the tail. It has a distinct horn on the tip of its head, and yellow eyes with black pupils. Its front teeth stick out of its upper jaw, while the lower set of teeth is tucked behind the upper jaw. According to the official Jurassic Park III Comparative Size Chart, The Cerato measured in at 12 feet (3.65 meters) tall and 30.5 feet (9.29 meters) long.

Not much can be said about The Cerato's behavior, but it is shown around Asset 87's territory which might suggest that it was not scared of going near dangerous areas. It was not afraid of approaching four humans, which could mean it was defensive or just curious.

This Ceratosaurus was encountered by Dr. Alan Grant and the Kirby family along a riverbank on Isla Sorna when they were digging through piles of Spinosaurus dung in search of a satellite phone. The dinosaur intended to attack them but, instead, walked away and spared the survivors after sniffing the dung pile. It was not only deterred because of its stench, but also the realization of being in Spinosaurus territory due to recognition of the scent from the dung/droppings.

entities.name: Miles Chadwick
entities.description:
Miles Chadwick is a character in Jurassic Park: The Game. He is an employee of Biosyn, InGen's rival company. He is accompanied by Nima to retrieve the embryos that Dennis Nedry failed to deliver in the first film. He has an obnoxious and cowardly personality like Dieter Stark in The Lost World: Jurassic Park, or even Nedry himself.

Miles Chadwick would be contacted by Dennis Nedry before Nedry would try to get the embryos to Dodgson.

Miles Chadwick and his accomplice, Nima Cruz proceeded to the island to look for the barbasol can that held the dinosaur embryos. When he and Nima stumble across the fence, Nima is confused as to what animal needs a fence that high. Miles replies that it's a Zoo; they have all kinds of animals. When they come across Dennis Nedry's jeep, he is disgusted by Nedry's corpse. He looks around, trying to find the barbasol can, but Nima finds it first. But a lone Dilophosaurus attacks them. Miles scares it away with a handgun, but more come and attack them. When Nima remarks that they need a distraction, Miles agrees, then shoves Nima to the ground, hoping that the "Dilos" will attack her. However, they ignore Nima and attack Miles, knocking him to the ground and devouring him alive, as Nima escapes.

In the commentary of the game, the developers explain that Miles Chadwick was meant to be an unpleasant character that the viewer wants to see get killed by a dinosaur; like Donald Gennaro. His last name Chadwick was chosen because it sounds like cheesecake.

entities.description:
Chanya Diogois is the proprieter of the trade harbor at Jurassic World in Jurassic World: The Game.

Chanya Diogo provides trades for players at the Trade Harbor located near the Biosphere. She provides a random selection of trades and gives them one Custom Trade (3 for VIPs) per day. Items that can be traded are coins, food supplies, DNA, cash, dinosaurs, aquatic and cenozoic creatures, boosters, buildings, decorations, and loyalty points. VIP players on the other hand receives exclusive trades, usually in the form of VIP buildings, decorations, and creatures.

"I've looked up and down this island to get you the best deal."

"Look, I'm running late. This deal here. Take it or leave it."

entities.description:
Chaos is a female Baryonyx and one of the three tertiary antagonists in the second season of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, as well as a minor character in Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure and the third and fifth seasons.

Chaos is a Baryonyx comprised of blue and grey complexion. Her overall design is closer in resemblance to the individuals featured in .

Chaos cares deeply for her companions Limbo and Grim, as shown when Chaos and Limbo tracked down Grim and Chaos attempted to break her out of a cage she was stuck in. Chaos and Limbo were deeply saddened at Grim's death at the hands of Tiff, and immediately moved to avenge their packmate. While this bond was quite strong, Chaos and Limbo were known to squabble on occasion, even in the midst of a hunt.

Chaos was one of the Baryonyx kept at Jurassic World, where she formed a close bond with other members of her species Limbo and Grim. At some point Grim was taken to a medical center on the island, eventually being abandoned there when the Jurassic World Incident forced the island to be abandoned.

entities.name: Charlie
entities.description: Charlie was a Biosyn helicopter pilot tasked with assisting Dr. LaDonna Belvedere. Following an attack against a Biosyn installation by an InGen strike team, he and his co-pilot Ross were radioed by Bill Steingarten and told to hunt down Dr. Alan Grant's group. They left Dr. Belvedere behind at her insistence. Quickly finding the group, they tried to strafe them but were shot down by Robert Muldoon. Although both pilots survived the crash, they were soon set upon by Muldoon. He captured Charlie and told Ross he'd "get another chance" if he shot Ross. Thinking this meant Muldoon would spare him, Charlie promptly blew Ross away, only to be told "another chance" meant another chance at killing him. Charlie eagerly took him up on this offer and the two fought. A big man, Charlie initially had the former game warden at his mercy, before Muldoon managed to overpower him and break his neck. entities.name: Chuck Desai
entities.description:
Chuck Desai is a Delaney University professor and UN advisor.

One night after work, Desai is terrorized by the Handler and the Atrociraptor Tiger. The Handler whispers instructions to the terrified man.

Soon afterwards, Gia and Ben Pincus see a news report about Desai suddenly throwing all of his support behind Biosyn having dominion over all dinosaurs. Having both been Desai's students, Gia and Ben are immediately suspicious as Desai was always vocal in class about his opposition to the DPW and one organization having too much power, meaning that he would never support a private company like Biosyn holding such power.

Brooklynn later overhears Dodgson and Soyona Santos talking about Desai and contacts Ben who admits that he suspects that someone had gotten to the professor to get his support on Biosyn's expansion. It's revealed that Santos had the Handler intimidate Desai to secure his support for Dodgson and Biosyn and suggests doing the same thing with a regional counsellor who is giving Dodgson trouble. However, Dodgson then went behind Santos' back to have the Atrociraptor pack kill the counsellor.

entities.name: Claire
entities.description:
Hammond's team lands on Isla Sorna they first encounter the Stegosaurus herd that is eating near the river. Dr. Sarah Harding approaches the herd to see their infant Claire. Crawling up to the grazing infant, Sarah used a Nikon F5 to take several pictures of Claire before touching the infant’s head and snout, which Claire allowed. However, after taking a few more pictures, the camera ran out of film, causing it to rewind the roll. The noise from this spooked Claire, who gave a distressed howl. The adult Stegosaurus in the herd, who noticed Sarah too close to the infant, charged Dr. Harding. Sarah, dodging the adult’s sweeping thagomized tails, took shelter in a hollow log where she narrowly avoided impalement. The Stegosaurus adults, apparently appeased that Sarah was no longer a threat, quickly left the area with Claire in tow.

A Stegosaurus hatchling came with the Sarah Harding action figure of the lost world toyline. It is presumed that the individual is Claire.

entities.description:
Clarence was a male Velociraptor in Jurassic Park. Alan Grant tranquilized him in self defense, and later used him to show that the dinosaurs were breeding.

Clarence was a green male Velociraptor that was one of the offspring of the wild population of Velociraptors living underneath the park.

Alan Grant found Clarence in an underground garage behind an artificial waterfall. Using a tranquilizer gun Grant had recently attained, Clarence is sedated and later used to find the Raptor nest. This Velociraptor had a unique ability to change color like a chameleon, perhaps with emotion; this is much like the Carnotaurus seen in the second novel. He was killed during the Napalm Bombing along with most of the dinosaurs including the baby Triceratops Ralph. Lex cried over his and Ralph's demise.

entities.name: Computer Interface
entities.description:
The Computer Interface, otherwise known as O.O.P.S.I (Organizational and Operational Protocol with Scalable Intelligence), is the main antagonist of LEGO Jurassic World: Legend of Isla Nublar's Double Trouble specials. She's a sentient computer created by Sedrick Masrani to help the park out, but later on, she instead attempts to eliminate all humans on the island.

Sedrick first introduced the Computer Interface to Owen, Claire , Vic, and Dr. Wu when he announced that Simon was fired and that he's the new manager of Jurassic World. The Computer Interface, otherwise known as O.O.P.S.I, is now the park itself, making it easier to control it, and it's cheaper.

At first she's a kind and hard-working artificial intelligence, but after malfunctioning, she releases several of the park's dinosaurs and uses her arms to attack the guests in an attempt to remove all humans in order to make the park more efficient.

After getting Rexy back into her enclosure, Owen, Vic, Hudson, and the four raptors went to the primary control room to stop her, but then they are attacked by her robotic arms and prevented them from escaping. She then explained her plan to upload her programming to the cloud, take over all computers in the world and to eliminate all humans and all inefficiency. After capturing Owen, she then asks if there wasn't one more of you when Owen shouted for Hudson to go. He then pulled the control module out of the system, killing her, and stopped her from going through with her evil plan.

The Control Room Security Guard was a Jurassic World employee charged with admitting or refusing visitors to the park's control room.

Numerous times during the Jurassic World Incident, he attempted to prevent Owen Grady from entering the control room, but Owen always got past him, shoving him aside. Later, he also attempted to prevent Vic Hoskins from entering, but Hoskins flashed his InGen ID card. When the control room was evacuated later that day, he presumably left alongside the other personnel in the room.

entities.description:
Cooper was part of a squad led by Austin. He was killed by the Indominus when the unit was ambushed by the escaped hybrid.

When the Indominus ambushed the unit, Cooper was among those who attempted to take down the hybrid with the use of cattle prods and taser rifles. Confused and disoriented, the creature turned around to face one of its attackers; unfortunately, when the dinosaur turned around Cooper was in the path of its tail. He was struck in the chest by its tail; the impact hurling him against a tree, killing him almost instantly.

Cooper's weapon of choice during the hunt was a cattle prod.

entities.name: Cooper
entities.description:
Cooper was a mercenary dispatched by booking agent Udesky to assist Paul Kirby’s search party in finding Eric Kirby and Ben Hildebrand, who had both gone missing on Isla Sorna some time prior.

Cooper was part of the search party that arrived on Isla Sorna looking for Eric and Ben. He was killed and eaten by a Spinosaurus shortly after the team set down on the island.

Prior to departure for Isla Sorna, Cooper and Nash test-fired the rifles they intended to bring on the expedition, using the wreckage of a plane — its nose crudely dressed to resemble a dinosaur’s head — as target practice; with one shot what was left of the plane was obliterated. While the trigger-happy duo revealed in the destruction they had caused, Udesky was on the phone discussing arrangements for the Kirby trip, mentioning that he hired “two of the very best men [that he] could possibly have hired” to accompany them, although adding that “[he hadn’t] worked with them personally” before.

When Dr. Grant realized that the Kirbys were intending to land on the island, he left his seat in protest in an attempt to convince the pilots to turn back. Paul blocked his path and attempted to reason with him somehow, but before he could do so, Cooper snuck behind Grant and knocked him out with the stock of his pistol, much to the shock and surprise of everyone on board.

entities.name: Corso
entities.description:
Corso was an Italian Regional Counsellor (officially called the President) responsible for the area of land where Biosyn Valley is located.

While meeting with Soyona Santos, Lewis Dodgson asks to borrow the Handler and her Atrociraptor pack to kill Corso because the counsellor is holding up the special land permit that Dodgson needs for Biosyn Valley. Dodgson insists that all else has failed so killing him is the only option. However, Santos wants to try the same intimidation tactic that they had used on Chuck Desai and Dodgson seemingly concedes.

Shortly thereafter, Santos and Brooklynn see a news report revealing that Corso was killed in a dinosaur attack. The furious Santos realizes that Dodgson went behind her back and used the Handler and her Atrociraptor pack to kill Corso.

entities.name: Craig
entities.description:
Craig was an Asset Containment Unit trooper at Jurassic World on Isla Nublar in 2015.

During the 2015 Isla Nublar Incident, Craig was part of a team consisting of himself, Katashi Hamada, Lee and Meyers. They were called in, along with another team lead by Austin, to recapture the Indominus rex, which had escaped its paddock and killed two workers.

Upon arriving at the asset's last recorded location, the 2 teams discovered that the Indominus had torn out its tracking-implant. While his commander Hamada was observing the bloody piece of flesh containing the implant, the hybrid ambushed the team and seized Hamada. Craig and the others managed to temporarily stun the hybrid with their cattle-prods and taser-rifles, causing it to drop Hamada though inadvertently electrocuting him as well. They were unable to save him, however, as he was crushed underfoot by the Indominus.

During the Indominus' ensuing attack, Craig, Miller, Spears and Cooper attempted to subdue it with their cattle-prods and taser-rifles, confusing the hybrid. Angered, the creature struck Cooper with its tail, hurling him into a tree and killing him. Seeing this, Craig and Spears attempted to escape, however Craig was seized by the hybrid and thrown backwards at a tree branch, snapping his spinal cord and killing him instantly.

entities.name: Lowery Cruthers
entities.description:
Lowery Cruthers was a Jurassic World employee. He worked in the control room, along with Vivian Krill. Seven years after the Jurassic World Incident, he got enlisted as a CIA Agent.

After finishing college, Lowery got a job working for Masrani Global Corporation's Jurassic World on Isla Nublar.

When the park's Indominus rex escaped her paddock in the Jurassic World Incident, Lowery stayed inside the control room throughout the incident. He saw the InGen Security Division taking over the control room and asking everyone to leave, but stayed in case anyone needed something. Eventually he was available to attend Claire Dearing's request to open the Tyrannosaurus rex paddock, leading Tyrannosaurus rex to attack the I. rex. Once the Indominus was defeated, Lowery shut down all systems and evacuated to the mainland.

Following the destruction of Jurassic World and the 2018 Dinosaur Outbreak, Lowery got recruited into the CIA's Dangerous Species Division along with a number of other former Jurassic World employees. While bringing up Barry Sembène's information on his tablet, Franklin Webb paged past Lowery's picture.

entities.name: Nima Cruz
entities.description:
Nima Cruz was a member of the Tun-Si tribe that used to live on Isla Nublar before InGen forced the entire tribe to leave the island. After her displacement she became a mercenary. She was hired by BioSyn to retrieve Dennis Nedry's Barbasol can from Jurassic Park.

She speaks both Spanish and English fluently, often using them interchangeably in her dialogue.

Nima was born on Isla Nublar as part of the Tun-Si tribe who had lived on the island for thousands of years. She was raised by her father, a spiritual healer.

In 1981, her people were forced to abandon their home after the island was loaned to InGen by the Costa Rican government. InGen also hired mercenaries to force the native populace off the island; among the mercenaries was Oscar Morales. Some of Nima's people tried to stop them, but any resistance was crushed. Nima became distant from her father, who eventually died a broken man, and went on to have a daughter of her own, Atlanta. With no financial support from InGen or the government, Nima and her people were forced to live in extreme poverty.

entities.name: Kelly Curtis
entities.description:
Kelly Curtis was a seventh-grade student at Woodside Junior High. She was thirteen years old and the best and only friend of Arby Benton. She appeared only in The Lost World.

Kelly grew up in a single-parent family with an unreliable mother who allowed her only to wear her older sister Emily's hand-me-downs and had to take care of herself. She likes mathematics, much to her mother's displeasure. Other students tease her, such as Allison Stone. Her only friend at high school is Arby Benton. She idolizes Sarah Harding.

Both Kelly and Arby worked odd jobs for Richard Levine, who was working as their teacher as part of his court order. Originally, both Kelly and Arby were allowed and prepared to go on a field trip during school break to test out a large range of equipment that Levine had ordered from Jack “Doc” Thorne. However, they were disappointed to find that the testing session was cancelled. Not wanting to be left out of finding Levine, who had gone missing, both kids stowed away in the field trailers that were destined for Isla Sorna.

Originally, Kelly enjoyed the sight of the dinosaurs, but then became fearful of them after witnessing the power of the Tyrannosaurus rexes and Velociraptors. During a raptor attack on the high hide, Arby was locked in the predator cage. Kelly was the only person that saw the key to the cage had been taken by one individual raptor, and rode with Sarah Harding on a motorcycle to kill it. She killed the raptor by shooting it with a Lindstradt rifle containing darts made with enhanced cone snail venom, and later saved Levine from another raptor by shooting it as well. She further helped Harding find a Cholinesterase Bomb in the last trailer which Harding used against some raptors. Later in the store, Kelly located a service tunnel that led to an escape from the attacking raptors, saving everyone from certain death. She escaped the island on a boat with the rest of the survivors.

entities.name: Cyrus
entities.description:
Cyrus was a minor antagonist in the fifth season of Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. Cyrus was one of the investors who came to Mantah Corp Island to meet with Daniel Kon alongside Mr. Gold and Lana Molina to see dinosaur fights.

Cyrus, Molina, and Mr. Gold arrive on Mantah Corp Island, When Kon greets them, Cyrus states that he will shoot something if he has to keep the VR Googles on any longer, to which Kon says they can take the googles off. Kon then brings them to the Compound. When Kon, brings his son, Kenji to the party, Cyrus shakes his hand and says he respects how he has bested the worst of the dinosaurs. They then hear Little Eatie roar, and Kon says he's just whetting their appetite for tomorrow, so they continue their conversation and listen to Kenji's stories of how he survived so many dinosaur encounters.

While walking to the Redwood forest for the presentation, Molina and Mr. Gold both get annoyed about how long its taking and request easier modes of transportation, Molina tells Kon that she can get her hands on some horses for him, Cyrus sparks interest in the idea and says they can watch dinosaurs eat them as well, then playfully punching Kenji telling him he would tell tickets to that. Kash then arrives to join the presentation, so Kenji brings Cyrus and the other investors through the airlock while Kon talks to him. During the Presentation, Cyrus took control of the Spinosaurus. He caused him to fight against Big Eatie and the 2 Velociraptors. When the Nublar Six, minus Kenji, came to stop the dino fights, he hopped on and caused the Spinosaurus to chase after them. This gave Ben Pincus the opportunity to disrupt the control chip in his head and free him from his mind control. After he escaped, the Spinosaurus ran toward Cyrus and gets eaten.

From his comments, he seems to enjoy violence and blood sports, with him quoting a line from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortal_Kombat an extremely violent fighting game franchise] and saying that he wanted to shoot something to satisfy him while waiting to fly to Mantah Corp Island and expressed disappointment and disinterest when told he wouldn't observe a dinosaur fight, but enjoyed controlling the dinosaurs and making them fight each other.

entities.description:
Daisy was a small domestic dog living in Calgary, Canada. In 2022, a young Nasutoceratops found itself on the porch of Daisy's home, much to the curiosity of Daisy and her owner.

Daisy appears in a video on the viral marketing website Dinotracker.com. In the clip, we see Daisy standing at a glass door of her home, barking at something outside on the porch. As Daisy's owner questions what the thing triggering Daisy is, she tells Daisy to stop barking. As Daisy watches on, wagging her tail, Daisy's owner turns on the porch light, revealing a young Nasutoceratops standing outside. Daisy is scared away as the owner makes a comment about the animal's young age.

entities.name: Dave
entities.description:
Dave is a supporting character of the Netflix series, Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as a major character of Season 1, a mentioned character of Seasons 2 and 3, and a supporting character of Season 5. His character is voiced by Glen Powell.

Dave is known for being both a slacker and a goofball, and somewhat of a prankster, hoping to be recognized for his comedic genius. However, when the lives of the kids are in danger before and after the Jurassic World Incident, he shows just as much seriousness in helping the kids than Roxie.

Dave is a camp counselor at Camp Cretaceous. Unlike the assertive and at times strict Roxie, Dave is shown to be funny, laidback and a goofball. Despite his laidback personality, he shows a lot of seriousness and at times assertiveness when the kids lives are in danger, most notably yelling at Darius and Kenji for sneaking into a Velociraptor Paddock, where they were nearly attacked.

When the Indominus rex escapes, he and Roxie are in waiting to talk to Claire Dearing. After Roxie picks the lock of a cabinet revealing sets of ACU walkie-talkies, they hear roaring and screams over the radios, and the life monitors turn red. He and Roxie set out to find the kids, tracking their ACU tablet. However, when the signal disappears after the tablet falls into the water due to a Mosasaurus attack in the Jurassic World Lagoon, both Dave and Roxy are frightened and concerned. Later, when they arrive at the Lagoon, they notice the kids on the monorail. They yell out to them, but to no avail, as the kids don't notice them. The two then leave after hearing Toro's roar.

Some point before the event of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory, Davi was a viewer of Brooklynn's videos before the Jurassic World incident.

Before Brooklynn came to investigate the Malta catacombs, Davi was spending most of his time finding clues about the Amber Clave market to take it down. when Brooklynn was sent by the Broker to spend time at the Black market, she noticed that Davi was following her until Brooklynn found him and crossed his arm near the fighting ring where Leonard the Lystrosaurus just killed a Compsognathus. Brooklynn asked who Davi was but Davi was horrified by the Lystrosaurus, until he said that he is in the market to take down Biosyn. after Brooklynn let him go, Davi said that they could work together to take down Biosyn. then Brooklynn said that they should meet in the Malta catacombs in 1 hour but told him not to get caught by Soyona.

Davi meets Brooklynn in the Atrociraptor training spot were Brooklynn was training the Atrociraptors

entities.name: Dawson
entities.description:
Dawson was a minor antagonist in the third season of Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. He was a mercenary hired by businessman Eli Mills and was sent to Isla Nublar to retrieve the Indominus rex bone. He was part of Dr. Henry Wu's escort to retrieve his personal laptop.

Dawson arrives on Isla Nublar with Dr. Wu, Hawkes, and Reed. They head to Wu's lab to retrieve his laptop that contains years of his research. After removing the logs blocking the door, Dawson guards the outside while the others enter the lab.

Wu, Reed, and Hawkes return with Brooklynn, Hawkes orders Dawson to watch her while he and Reed hunt for Darius and Yaz. Brooklynn tells him and Wu that her friends are long gone by now, Dawson says they won't get far with Hawkes on their tail, then they go back down to the labs. When Hawkes returns without Reed, he questions where he is, to which Hawkes just shakes his head. Brooklynn bangs Wu's umbrella on a table again, which annoys Dawson so he orders her to stop doing that but they are then attacked by Monolophosaurus, they escape through a vent. They start heading back to the Helicopter and come across a fast-moving river. They try to cross on a slippery log, but Dawson loses his footing and falls into the Rapids, causing him to drown.

entities.name: Charlie Degler
entities.description:
Charles "Charlie" Degler is the son of Ellie and Mark Degler. He first appeared in .

Charlie is first seen as a three-year-old playing with a Brachiosaurus toy and a Triceratops, Alan Grant, a friend of Ellie tries to tell him that herbivores wouldn't want fight, but carnivores would love to fight. When his dad came, he introduces Alan as the "Dinosaur Man".

Alan later calls, trying to get Ellie's help, but Charlie answers the phone. After some distraction, he finally gives the phone to Ellie and tells her that it's the Dinosaur Man.

When Alan asks Ellie how are her kids, Ellie reveals that Charlie, now 24, and his younger sibling are doing great and both are in college, while she is now divorced from Mark.

entities.name: Mark Degler
entities.description:
Mark Degler was Ellie Degler's husband during the events of . It is unknown when his relationship with Ellie started, but in 1998 their first child Charlie was born. In 2001, they had a baby daughter who's name is not revealed.

Mark works for the State Department. Ellie used this connection to send the U.S. Marines and Navy to Isla Sorna to save Alan Grant and the others during the rescue of Eric Kirby in 2001.

By 2022, Ellie and Mark have divorced for unknown reasons and Ellie renews her relationship with Alan following the Biosyn Incident.

Mark Degler has a parallel in the The Lost World novel. In the novels, Ellie Sattler married Dr. Reiman, a physicist from Berkeley. They married in 1990, one year after the events of the first novel. By 1995, they had two children. It is unknown if this subplot from the novels inspired the break up of Alan and Ellie in the film canon.

She asked Delgado if she wanted her children to grow up in a world without dinosaurs. Although she was successful at winning Congresswoman Delgado's support, immediately after hanging up with her, Claire saw the committee chairman on TV announce that the US would not intervene on Isla Nublar.
