entities.name: Reuben Delgado
entities.description:
Teresa Delgado (older daughter)Isabella Delgado (younger daughter)}} Reuben Delgado is a father and a character in . He was stranded on Ile Saint-Hubert with his family.

Reuben Delgado married a woman and had two daughters, Teresa and Isabella. In 2027, Teresa was accepted into New York University. Wanting to have one last family adventure before she left, Reuben took his two daughters sailing in the Atlantic Ocean on his boat, La Mariposa. Teresa also brought along her boyfriend, Xavier Dobbs, to which Reuben reluctantly agreed to.

As Rueben's sailboat neared Ile Saint-Hubert, they were capsized by a Mosasaurus as it perceived their boat to be a competitor in its territory. Reuben, Teresa, Isabella, and Xavier survived the incident and managed to retrieve the radio in which Reuben spent the night calling for help. The following day, they were discovered by The Essex. The crew aboard were mercenaries led by Duncan Kincaid and Zora Bennett, assisted by paleontologist Doctor Henry Loomis. They were employed by Martin Krebs, a representative for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering. They were bound for Ile Saint-Hubert to obtain living tissue samples from three of the largest cloned dinosaurs on the island so their material could be used to develop a cure for heart disease. This was considered an illegal operation that Krebs wanted kept secret, and assured Reuben that he and his family would be dropped off at the village on the island as it's powered by geothermal energy.

The Mosasaurus was among the dinosaurs they were targeting, and Bennett was able to obtain a sample. However, as they approached the island, the Mosasaurus, along with a pack of Spinosaurs, attacked the ship. Crew member Bobby Atwater was killed by a Spinosaurus in front of Reuben's family. Kincaid drove the ship towards the island in shallow waters to keep the boat from getting further attacked, but this required everyone jumping ship. Reuben had Teresa go to the radio and call for help. Desperate to keep the mission a secret, Krebs followed Teresa and kept her from radioing for help. As the boat was struck, Teresa fell overboard due to Krebs intentionally letting her fall. Xavier went in the waters after her, followed by Reuben and Isabella. The family reunited, and Teresa revealed to Reuben that Krebs kept her from radioing for help and let her fall overboard. While the remaining Essex crew continued with their mission, Reuben led his family to the village by following the geothermal pipes. Along the way, Isabella encountered an Aquilops she named Dolores and brought along with them. Dolores was able to warn Reuben's family of nearby danger. The following night, Reuben thanked Xavier for saving his daughter. Xavier expressed inadequacy about himself compared to Teresa, not knowing why she loves him. Reuben assured him that he was good enough and that he shouldn't let other people make him think he's less than.

entities.name: Denise Roberts
entities.description:
Denise Roberts is a Biosyn employee, responsible for the ADS and air system from the Valley.

When Kayla Watts requests landing for freight delivery on Biosyn's valley, Denise refuses it, stating that Watts is carrying unauthorized passengers, i.e. Owen Grady and Claire Dearing. Watts insists, but Denise demands her to return to point of origin. Afterwards, Jeffrey calls Lewis Dodgson to warn him that these unauthorized passengers are Maisie's parents. Dodgson demands to shut off the ADS system, which led to a Quetzalcoatlus to attack Kayla’s cargo plane.

After Dodgson found out that Grant and Sattler got a locust sample from the restricted lab, he shuts down their hyperloop pod that was heading to the airfield. Denise announces that said pod stopped at the Amber Mines, and Ramsay tells Dodgson to send a security team for them, but Dodgson doesn't do it.

When a wildfire is caused by the burning locusts in the sanctuary, she declares an evacuation in the facility and announces that the dinosaurs were being remotely herded into the facility. She and other employees evacuated from the facility.

entities.name: Desanto
entities.description:
Desanto was an InGen Employee working at a research facility on Ile Saint-Hubert. She witnessed Williams get eaten in an accident with the Distortus rex.

In 2010, Desanto was doing a procedure with Williams and other scientists in the Distortus rex pen. Williams' Snickers bar wrapper got sucked into an airlock for the pen's doors, which started a system failure and emergency closure of the doors. Her and the other scientists got out of the pen, but Williams did not make it out in time.

Desanto ran up to the door and put the key in to let Williams out, but saw the Distortus rex coming up behind him. She pulled the key out of the door, shaking. Williams plead with her to let him out, but she refused to risk the escape of the Distortus rex. The creature grabbed Williams, put him in its mouth as he was screaming, and turned around. She yelled she was sorry many times in emotional agony.

entities.name: Diego
entities.description:
Diego or Dieguito was a Costa Rican man who guided Dr. Richard Levine part of the way across Isla Sorna.

He knew the outline of the island very well as he visited it previously as a young boy. He carried most of the equipment as they climbed up one of the cliffs to get on the island. He was amazed by even the smallest dinosaurs. Levine considered him sloppy and careless, such as making too much noise or smoking when he had been specifically told not to. Diego was dragged into the bushes and was killed by a Carnotaurus. Levine only noted which kind of dinosaur killed Diego later on.

Diego had a cousin named Gandoca who owned a boat. He gave doctors Lewis Dodgson, Howard King, George Baselton, and Sarah Harding a boat ride to Isla Sorna.

entities.name: Dieter Stark
entities.description:
Dietrich Viggo "Dieter" Stark was a member of the hunting team sent to Isla Sorna to capture the dinosaurs on the island, acting as Roland Tembo's second-in-command. When several incidents led to the team being stranded on the island with a separate team known as the gatherers, Dieter and the others reluctantly join forces with the gatherers for survival.

He was subsequently attacked by a pack of Compsognathus after wandering off alone and becoming lost in the jungle, and killed by the pack. His blood trickled down by the lake that he fell in at the last moments of his death.

Stark was Tembo's second-in-command during the hunting trip to Isla Sorna. His position as number two was one of Roland's conditions for joining the team.

Following the team's arrival on Isla Sorna, Stark joined the mission to capture the herbivore dinosaurs on one of the island's game trails. Sitting in the passenger seat of a modified jeep driven by Carter, he was ordered by Tembo to help subdue an adult male Parasaurolophus (whom the latter dubbed Elvis after being unable to pronounce its name). Laughing at Tembo's expense, Stark then ordered Carter to move him out into the jeep's extendable seat and tranquilized Elvis. Panicking, Elvis fled in the direction of another group of hunters, who subsequently subdued it.

entities.name: Xavier Dobbs
entities.description:
Xavier Dobbs is a character in Jurassic World: Rebirth. He is the boyfriend to Teresa Delgado.

Wanting to have one last family adventure before Teresa left for college, her father Reuben Delgado took his two daughters, Teresa and Isabella, sailing in the Atlantic Ocean on his boat, La Mariposa. They also brought along her boyfriend, Xavier Dobbs, to which Reuben reluctantly agreed to.

As the Delgados' sailboat neared Ile Saint-Hubert, they were capsized by a Mosasaurus as it perceived their boat to be a competitor in its territory. Reuben, Teresa, Isabella, and Xavier survived the incident and managed to retrieve the radio in which Reuben spent the night calling for help. The following day, they were discovered by The Essex. The crew aboard were mercenaries led by Duncan Kincaid and Zora Bennett, assisted by paleontologist Dr. Henry Loomis. They were employed by Martin Krebs, a representative for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering. They were bound for Ile Saint-Hubert to obtain living tissue samples from three of the largest cloned dinosaurs on the island so their material could be used to develop a cure for heart disease. This was considered an illegal operation that Krebs wanted kept secret, and assured Reuben that he and his family would be dropped off at the village on the island as it's powered by geothermal energy.

The Mosasaurus was among the dinosaurs they were targeting, and Bennett was able to obtain a sample. However, as they approached the island, the Mosasaurus, along with a pack of Spinosaurs, attacked the ship. Reuben had Teresa go to the radio and call for help. Desperate to keep the mission a secret, Krebs followed Teresa and kept her from radioing for help. As the boat was struck, Teresa fell overboard due to Krebs intentionally letting her fall. Xavier went in the waters after her, followed by Reuben and Isabella. The family reunited, and Teresa revealed to Reuben that Krebs kept her from radioing for help and let her fall overboard. While the remaining Essex crew continued with their mission, Reuben led his family to the InGen village complex by following the geothermal pipes.

entities.name: Tyrannosaur Doe
entities.description:
CGI (Jurassic World: Dominion and Jurassic World: Chaos Theory)

In and Jurassic World: Chaos Theory, the Doe appears as a minor character with her mate.

The Doe was one of the seven T. rex cloned by InGen on Isla Sorna. She and a male of her species had a son in 1997.

During the Isla Sorna Incident, the Doe's son was taken from her by the InGen Hunters where they used him as bait to attract her partner. She and Buck, upon finding their son missing, let out a huge bellow of anger that could be heard on the other side of the island. Immediately resolved to tracking him, they located their child's scent and went to retrieve their captured son. Upon arriving in the encampment, she made her presence known by flipping one of the Gatherers' Mercedes-Benz M-Class SUVs over the cliff the team parked on. She, along with her mate, then reveal themselves to the humans inside the Fleetwood RV Mobile Lab, and make a series of low growls and roars, indicating their presence is for their infant. Despite the infant having been returned to them, the pair decided to destroy the humans as a probable continued threat to their child. They put the young male in a safe place before returning to the trailers. Flipping the rear half of the accordioned vehicle upside down the two proceeded to smash the windshield of the vehicle and then push the rear trailer over the cliff, leaving it hanging hundreds of feet from the rocky shore below. Apparently satisfied with their work, the two leave. However, drawn by the sounds of Eddie Carr's Mercedes SUV, the couple return and the Buck proceeded to dismantle the vehicle before lifting Eddie up and ripping him in half in a tug-of-war with the female before finally eating him. Despite Eddie's death, the subsequent destruction of both trailers and the remaining SUV, the team were saved by the InGen expedition team.thumb|leftDespite having her son returned her, she and the Buck continued to pursue the human visitors because they smelled the blood of their infant that had gotten on Dr. Sarah Harding's shirt when she was repairing his leg, also motivated by their parental instincts. She let her mate go first into the humans' camp, which caused the inhabitants to go into a mass panic. The Female Tyrannosaur then burst out of the brush and ambushed the scattering mercenaries; Roland Tembo, upon catching sight of her, tried to shoot her with his elephant gun (possibly mistaking her for the male) but she was saved because Nick van Owen had previously sabotaged the rifle's ammunition. Chasing the terrified mercenaries out of the camp and into the jungle, ignoring the sporadic gunfire aimed at scaring her off, she kills the InGen Hunter, Carter, by crushing him with her right foot after he trips and lands in a puddle. As she continues walking she is unaware that he is still alive and he is eventually crushed to death as the Tyrannosaurus rex continues pursuing his fellow colleagues.

entities.name: Dolores
entities.description:
Dolores is a female Aquilops who was befriended by Isabella Delgado in Jurassic World: Rebirth. Dolores is friendly and fairly tame, allowing to be held and carried around by people.

Dolores is light orangish-brown, with brown stripes on her tail. Her back is a more vibrant orange. Her legs remain the orange color, while the forelimbs have a tan color after the elbow. Dolores' head is a yellow orange, with brown horns and a lighter brown beak. Her eyes are a dark brown. She has a horn on top of her snout and on her beak.

After the Delgado family was marooned on Ile Saint-Hubert, Dolores was first seen coming out of the bushes, scaring Isabella Delgado before being scared away by Teresa. However, Dolores reappeared at night and Isabella gave her a piece of liquorice. Dolores started following her and slept with the Delgado family.

When Isabella's family started moving again to find the village, Dolores followed Isabella and was given her name. Dolores was placed in Isabella's bag and accompanied the Delgado family. Before encountering a T. rex, Dolores ran off. The family found the village and reunited with the crew that saved them. While hiding from the Mutadons in a gas station, Isabella found Dolores again. Dolores was brought off the island with the family.

entities.name: Donald Gennaro
entities.description:
Donald Gennaro was a lawyer sent by Cowan, Swain & Ross to inspect Jurassic Park. He was also the general counsel for InGen. He appears in both the book and film. Although he survives in the novel, in the film he was killed by the newly-escaped Tyrannosaurus rex. Both depictions of the character are extremely different in most regards.

Donald Gennaro was a lawyer who represented the investors of John Hammond's Jurassic Park. He is described in the script as:

DONALD GENNARO, forty, in a city man's idea of hiking clothes and a hundred dollar haircut...

Before visiting the park for a "site inspection", Gennaro went to the Mano de Dios Amber Mine and discussed with miner Juanito Rostagno how the investors were concerned about the park's security after the incident with a worker. Gennaro mentions that the $20 million lawsuit Hammond is facing from the worker's family is a huge liability and the investors would like to get Alan Grant to inspect the park, but Juanito told him they'd never get Grant away from his current dig in Montana, apparently underestimating how persuasive Hammond could be.

entities.name: Dorje
entities.description:
Dorje was a female baby snow leopard that lived in the San Francisco Zoo.

When Dr. Ian Malcolm was at the San Francisco Zoo to examine a skin fragment that Dr. Richard Levine had extracted from an unknown animal, the report on the skin was delayed due to the afternoon animal feeding inside the nursery of the zoo's research laboratory. Malcolm witnessed the feedings of a baby gorilla, a koala, and finally Dorje as he waited. While Dorje was being fed, Gelman told Malcolm Dorje like to be petted. Malcolm therefore attempted to stroke the leopard's belly, but when he reached his hand out, the female leopard bit him, though the bite failed to break through his skin.

entities.description:
Jim Drucker was a businessman from Verizon investing in Jurassic World.

Claire Dearing took him on a tour of the Hammond Creation Lab along with Hal Osterly and Erica Brand. When being shown the Indominus rex at the prompting of Osterly, Drucker asked how they'd gotten two different kinds of dinosaurs to procreate, prompting Henry Wu to walk over and explain that Indominus rex wasn't bred, she was designed. He is not seen for the rest of the movie and his whereabouts are unknown other than the fact that he is alive.

entities.description:
Soyona Santos's Dinosaur Trafficking Ring}}

Dudley Cabrera was a Hispanic-American regional district manager who was employed as the regional director for the Department of Prehistoric Wildlife in the American Southwest, where he secretly worked with smugglers in administrating the illegal buying and selling of dinosaurs, a harbor facility in the South Center of Louisiana on the Gulf Coast near the Atchafalaya river basin, was the major drop point for his illegal activities. He was the secondary antagonist in season 1 of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

He was working with the Atrociraptor Handler and for her employer Soyona Santos in the smuggling ring and eventually helped them take care of the Nublar Six.

Dudley Cabrera was characterized by pride, selfishness and egoism, claiming that he doesn't want to hurt people on purpose, however he shows no guilt in doing so, he was also extremely greedy, even implying that if he has to make a choice between his operation and the Nublar Six lives, he would choose the operation, other enforce of his egoism, is the fact that he tried to obligate the Nublar Six to do his biding despite the group clearly rejecting the offer, however, despite his arrogance, Cabrera was not completely immoral, he had also a more moral side, as it is showed that he doesn't want to kill the Nublar Six, and sent the Allosaurus just to scare Brooklynn, furthermore he showed to care about the way his employers were mistreating the dinosaurs.

entities.name: Sonya Durant
entities.description:
Sonya Durant was an African guide working for BioSyn to investigate the strange occurrences on Isla Nublar. She appears solely in the Jurassic Park comics. She is featured in the Return to Jurassic Park series. She is said to be the only female guide west of Tanganyika and, according to Robert Muldoon, the best.

She and her partner, Raul Lopez, encounter Drs Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler, Edgar Prather and Muldoon on Nublar, and though there is an initial argument, multiple attacks (from a flock of Cearadactylus, which results in Sonya being handed a gun by Alan; and then by the army forces on the island) result in the two groups deciding to make a temporary alliance. Later, the group is attacked by the island’s Tyrannosaurus; it picks Sonya up in its mouth, but a shot from Alan makes it drop her, and Edgar tends to her wounds. The two then go off to talk, and Edgar kisses her – although she tries to resists, she eventually gives in. After this, the group sails across a river, and are attacked again by the Rex; upon landing, they come across the army’s base. Sonya decides to go with Edgar to the base; Edgar grapples up a fence and into a guard outpost, and then helps Sonya up. Sonya acts as a guard, letting the others escape, though not before noticing something; she then joins them as they flee in a jeep. At dawn, Ellie and Sonya talk; when Ellie asks her about her and Edgar, Sonya replies that it’s “just what you see”. When a Rex attack splits the group up, Edgar asks Sonya what the secret of the “Green Flame” is – when she refuses to answer, he knocks her over a cliff and leaves her hanging there until she talks. When she does, he drops her anyway.

entities.name: Fallon Durgray
entities.description:
Fallon Durgray is one of few of Maisie Lockwood's friends, they met at the school Maisie attended during the events of Yosemite Six.

During the events of Yosemite Six, Maisie attended school where she met Fallon, who introduces herself as the class president. The two seem to get along well and exchange ideas about their respective mothers. (Referring to Claire in Maisie's case).

Fallon mentions that his family used to camp and enjoy the outdoors until the events of Lockwood Mansion occurred, where the entire world had changed.

One day a snowstorm occurs, so Maisie and Fallon cannot leave school, an Allosaurus enters the place, putting the children at risk. Fallon, Maisie and Grace put on hockey gear to face some adversities that occurred at the school, where other dinosaurs had entered. Thanks to what Maisie had learned from Owen, she was able to outwit the Allosaurus, saving Fallon from a terrible fate. After everything that happened, Maisie has to leave Yosemite, so Fallon says goodbye, promising to keep in touch.

entities.description:
Earhart is a dog that is owned by Claire Dearing and Karen Mitchell 's mother and father in The Evolution of Claire. Earhart is a mix of Mutt, Labrador Retriever and Rottweiler breeds and has a considerable fascination with Claire's pet, Sally Ride. Her name is based on aviator Amelia Earhart.

Earhart is first seen waiting for Claire and Karen to arrive at their parents house. Earhart jumps down from the porch where Claire and Karen's mother and father are waiting and starts to follow Claire up the stairs to her old room, whilst staring intently at Sally, Claires blue-tongued skink. Earhart is then seen again playing outside with Zach Mitchell, Karen's child, and Pete (Scott) Mitchell with water balloons.

entities.name: Earnest
entities.description:
Earnest's personality can be characterized as passionate, determined, and somewhat radical. As the leader of Dinosaur Liberation Now, he is deeply committed to the cause of dinosaur freedom, which drives him to take aggressive actions against facilities that imprison these creatures. His strong sense of justice fuels his willingness to raid and confront those he views as oppressors, like the Broker.

Earnest is likely charismatic, able to inspire and rally his team around their shared mission. However, his fervor can also make him impulsive or reckless, prioritizing action over caution in his pursuit of liberation. This intensity may lead him to be somewhat idealistic, believing firmly in the righteousness of his cause, even if it means crossing ethical lines.

Overall, Earnest embodies the traits of a passionate activist, combining a fierce dedication to dinosaur rights with a willingness to engage in confrontational tactics to achieve his goals.

After meeting Earnest, an amused Yasmina Fadoula compares him to Kenji Kon when he first arrived at Camp Cretaceous and Darius Bowman realizes that she's right.

entities.name: Eddie
entities.description:
Eddie was a minor character in the Netflix series, Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. He was voiced by James Arnold Taylor.

Eddie was one of Dr. Henry Wu's assistants at the genetics lab. He was first seen working alongside Wu when Dave and Roxie brought Brooklynn, Ben Pincus, Sammy Gutierrez and Yasmina Fadoula to the facility for a tour while Kenji Kon and Darius Bowman were cleaning Dino poop back at camp as punishment for sneaking into the Velociraptor pen the night before. Later, after the kids escaped from the Indominus rex in an Asset Containment Unit van, they found their way to the Creation Lab and sought refuge inside along with Bumpy. Eddie was the only one present. It was his birthday and he was celebrating it by himself all alone in the darkened lab, complete with a birthday cake and party hat.

He refused to help the children, despite being the only adult present. Upon learning they'd arrived in a vehicle, he immediately abandoned them and ran outside. Kenji had left the keys in the ignition, allowing Eddie to steal the van and drive off in it. Yaz ran after him, but he outdistanced her. Suddenly, the I. rex appeared and sideswiped the van, knocking it off the road. Eddie attempted to get out, but the hybrid circled around, forcing him to get back inside. She thrust her snout in through the open driver's side door, and Eddie climbed into the back, escaping out through the rear doors and climbing under the vehicle to hide.

The Indominus, however flipped the van over, exposing Eddie, and she immediately ate him.

entities.name: Eddie
entities.description:
Eddie was a member of the Dig in the badlands of Montana.

The boy was among the many people who saw the x-ray of a recently excavated Velociraptor in June of 1993.

He derided the appearance of Velociraptor, calling it nothing more than a six-foot turkey and implying it wouldn't have been very scary. Dr. Alan Grant then scared the boy, suggesting a scenario in which he met a raptor in real life. Doctor Grant suggested that the raptor would distract him while other raptors would attack from the sides, then rip him apart using the retractable claw on their foot, spill his intestines, and be left alive when it begins to eat him. The child looks on in stunned silence.

While going to the trailer of the dig site, Ellie admonishes Alan that that was an overly graphic lesson for such a young child. Alan says Eddie's attitude was a main reason why he hates children. Grant's disdain for children would ultimately be undone after rescuing Tim and Lex Murphy, whose attitudes were much different than Eddie's.

entities.name: Elvis
entities.description:
Elvis was an adult male Parasaurolophus that was one of the dinosaurs which were supposed to inhabit to the new Jurassic Park in San Diego. Elvis was captured by the InGen Hunters during the events of .

Elvis received his nickname from Roland Tembo, who found himself incapable of pronouncing "Parasaurolophus". Tembo also mistook Elvis for a Corythosaurus due to the wind whipping the pages rapidly in Roland’s specimen packet. Near the end of the Game Trail harvest, Dieter Stark and Carter chased down Elvis in their modified Jeep. Dieter moved out into the Jeep’s outrigger, which was the extendable seat in the vehicle, and tranquilized the latter with a Dan-Inject JM Standard. As Elvis slowed down, the rest of the harvesters crowded around him with snare poles where they successfully brought Elvis down after little resistance. Fortunately, Elvis escaped along with the other dinosaurs thanks to Sarah Harding and Nick Van Owen.

entities.name: Ember
entities.description:
Ember is the sole Tyrannosaurus individual serving as a minor antagonist, living on Ile Saint-Hubert who pursued the Delgado family in the river chase scene during the events of Jurassic World: Rebirth.

Due to Ember's brief appearance in Jurassic World: Rebirth, Ember's personality seems rather curious, and impulsive too. Despite having a plentiful source of food, they went out of their way to chase down escaping humans that would be of no benefit to themselves. They could either have done this out of boredom, had a sort of personal hatred towards humans or simply wanted them out it's territory because of how far they went to pursue a quick-moving family.

Ember has a grey and yellowish-brown body with black tiger-like stripes running from its back to its tail. The right upper lip had a deep scar that extended to the bone, the cause of which is unclear. On both sides of its cheeks, it had subtympanic shields, similar to those found on modern animals like the green iguana. The purpose of these scales is unknown, but it is speculated that they may have served to enhance the overall structure, making it appear larger to other animals.

Like the four Spinosaurus, this Tyrannosaurus is a masterful swimmer.

entities.name: Daniel Espinoza
entities.description:
Daniel Espinoza is a Hispanic American CIA Agent sent to infiltrate the drug cartel of Gabriel Cazares who had taken over Isla Nublar by 2011. However, Espinoza was found out and then released into the jungle to be killed by either the dinosaurs or by Cazares' right hand man hunting him down. Espinoza fought back against the Cartel and worked alongside Frances White, an animal behaviorist who had lived amongst Velociraptors for almost twenty years.

Espinoza served as the main protagonist of the non canon IDW Publishing comic book series Jurassic Park: Dangerous Games.

Daniel Espinoza was an American of Hispanic heritage who in his adult life became an agent of the CIA. He operated in Latin American countries in order to investigate drug cartels which supplied various illegal drugs through the countries up into the United States. Three months prior to the events of the comic, Daniel arrived in Nicaragua with a female partner in the CIA to inform her on what he uncovered about Gabriel Cazares, a notorious Nicaraguan drug lord.

He revealed the names of Cazares' Mexican contacts but didn't know where the location of the fields where the drugs were grown. The woman revealed that Cazares had recently purchased Isla Nublar from the Costa Rican government. As the island was meant to be a sanctuary for the dinosaurs after the San Diego Incident, they suspected that Cazares paid someone off in the United Nations to allow the purchase. Espinoza revealed The two bid farewell as Espinoza headed off for his mission.

entities.name: Yasmina Fadoula
entities.description:
Yasmina is a multi-medal world track and field champion whose corporate sponsor was Jurassic World. However, due to constant training, she has not had time to have fun or make real friends, as her training regimen has led her to lead a disciplined and solitary life.

In the winter of 2015, Yaz was invited to participate in the Camp Cretaceous.

Yaz arrived on Isla Nublar at the Ferry Landing along with the other campers, and is greeted by Dave and Roxie. They are then taken to Camp Cretaceous, only stopping briefly when the counselors attempt to retrieve an escaped Compsognathus. Once at camp, Brooklynn tries to interview her as an athlete but Yaz simply avoids her, saying that she doesn't like being in front of cameras. That afternoon, all the campers, including Yasmina, have the opportunity to zipline over a herd of dinosaurs.

The next day, Yaz and the rest of the group (excluding Darius and Kenji, who were being punished for entering the Raptor Paddock) visit the Genetics Lab. She is present at Bumpy's birth, however she and the rest of the group are abruptly expelled by Dr. Wu in retaliation for Brooklynn's invasion of his office. When asked by Darius and Kenji, she stated that Brooklynn got them booted from the lab, officially nicknaming her "Superstar" for the first time.

Jimmy Fallon appeared in a Gyrosphere instruction video, where he said the glass is able to stop a 50 caliber bullet and can protect the guests from the venomous spit of a Dilophosaurus, with him acting as if he passed out from the venom. Zach Mitchell and Gray Mitchell, who were watching the instruction video sighed, implying they didn’t find the skit funny. In the end of the video the a device on the table begins to explode, causing Fallon to cover his head and scream frantically.

Farmer Peréz is a farmer who owns a farm in West Texas during the events of .

In 2022, Peréz's farm was devastated by a swarm of giant locusts which destroyed her crops. After this, she calls Dr. Ellie Sattler to investigate and complains to Sattler that the Department of Fish and Wildlife didn't even want to see the locust, as they are more concerned with activity concerning dinosausr. She also informs Sattler that her neighbor's crops were unscathed from the locusts as they used seeds manufactured by Biosyn and that her children, Alicia and Ramon, captured a live locust that Sattler took a sample of and later took the live locust to Dr. Alan Grant.

entities.description:
Baby Tyrannosaur (baby) Other babies|born=Before 1989}}The female Tyrannosaur was a Tyrannosaurus rex individual that lived on Isla Sorna. The female survived after being abandoned due to the 1989 incident. The female found also found a mate.

Created on Isla Sorna sometime during the mid to late '80s, the female and male Tyrannosaur would be bred and raised there until InGen would leave the island post the 1989 incident. It is unknown whether any other tyrannosaurs were housed on Sorna. However, during the six year timespan between the two novels the rexes would pair and have at least one successful brood.

After receiving Richard Levine's coordinates, Jack Thorne took a motorcycle to the T. rex nest. When Jack found Levine, Levine accidentally fell from the tree he was in. His fall made too much noise which alerted the tyrannosaur parents which were feeding their young, leading to the male to chase them away.

Later, the team of Biosyn agents lead by Dr. Lewis Dodgson tried to steal the eggs of Tyrannosaurs. The attempt fails, resulting in George Baselton being eaten, Howard King breaking the leg of one of the babies, and their jeep being pushed stuck in thick undergrowth. King and Dodgson were both rendered unconscious from the raid. Afterward, Eddie, believing that the juvenile could be healed and returned, secretly brought it back to the trailer.

entities.name: Firecracker
entities.description:
Firecracker is a baby Brachiosaurus that was created by Mantah Corp who appears in season 4 and season 5 of Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. She was named by Ben.

Firecracker uses the same model as the baby Brachiosaurus from season 3, but her color is more of a sandy brown instead of the baby and the Isla Nublar variant's gray.

During the 2010s, Mantah Corp managed to steal genetic material from several extinct animal species, including a Brachiosaurus sample taken from Isla Sorna. This sample was used to clone a female Brachiosaurus in April 2016, four months after the Jurassic World Incident.

Firecracker spent her days living in a glass cage on Mantah Corp Island until she was named and freed by Ben and the other campers along with the Spinoceratopes Rebel and Angel, It should be noted that his name changes in different languages.

entities.name: Jeremiah Fischer
entities.description:
Dr. Jeremiah Fischer is a scientist who assists the army in reorganizing Jurassic Park. He appears solely in the Jurassic Park comics. He appears first in Jurassic Park: Raptor, but is mainly featured in Jurassic Park: Raptors Hijack.

Dr. Fischer plays Dr. Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler into being dismissed from the island, before ultimately being dismissed himself. By this point, however, he has knowledge of the Park and of the missing Raptors, and is hired by Bill Steingarten, head of BioSyn, to find the Raptors and set up a new Jurassic Park. He hires Dr. LaDonna Belvedere as head-keeper in turn for having the Raptors, and proceeds to set up walls around the Raptors. When Ian Malcolm and Ellie stumble upon his “park”, he prepares to kill them, but the escaped Raptors turn on him and his men and kill them.

entities.name: Flight Instructor
entities.description:
The Flight Instructor was a helicopter pilot teaching Simon Masrani how to fly.

The flight instructor was riding in the co-pilot's seat of JW001 when Masrani picked Claire Dearing up and flew to Paddock 11. The bumpy ride and rough landing made him physically ill, and he was forced to run and vomit in the bushes. Claire, showing concern, asked Masrani if he was okay, to which Masrani simply replied that the instructor was "just being dramatic." He presumably flew back with them in JW001 after Masrani had finished inspecting the paddock.

Following the escape of Indominus rex and the demise of Commander Hamada and nearly his entire ACU team, Masrani took it upon himself to have a gun fitted to JW001 and pursue I.rex. Vivian Krill, concerned about her boss' piloting skills (or lack thereof), tried to locate the instructor, but failed, telling Masrani he seemed to have gotten caught up in the evacuation of the park. Masrani replied that he could fly the helicopter just fine.

entities.name: Friar Tuck
entities.description:
Friar Tuck was an adult Pachycephalosaurus from The Lost World: Jurassic Park, which was captured by the InGen Harvest team on an Isla Sorna game trail in 1997.

This particular Pachycephalosaurus was created by InGen sometime before 1993, where he was planned to be an attraction for Jurassic Park. However, he was never transferred to Isla Nublar and was released into the wilds of Isla Sorna after a hurricane had damaged the island's bases and resources. In 1997, the Pachycephalosaurus became part of a dinosaur stampede that were chased by the InGen Harvest Team. He was named by Roland Tembo who came up with the nickname out of his inability to pronounce “Pachycephalosaurus“. After being cornered by a group of harvesters, Friar Tuck managed to charge through the attempted captors and rammed one of the modified Jeeps, sending Carter through the vehicle. After chasing Friar Tuck back down, the harvesters used their Snagger vehicle to pin the Pachycephalosaurus down while the rest of the harvesters subdued the animal with snare poles. Like the other animals, Friar Tuck was freed by Sarah Harding and Nick Van Owen and attack Ludlow's men before running back into the wild.

entities.name: Gabriel
entities.description:
In Judaism, Christianity, Islam, and other Abrahamic religions, Gabriel ( GAY-bree-əl) is an archangel with the power to announce God's will to humankind as the messenger of God. He is mentioned in the Hebrew Bible, the New Testament and the Quran.

In the Book of Daniel, Gabriel appears to the prophet Daniel to explain his visions. Gabriel also appears in the Jewish apocryphal First Book of Enoch (e.g., 1 Enoch 20:7–8) and other ancient Hebrew writings incompletely preserved or wholly lost in Hebrew. Alongside the archangel Michael, Gabriel is described as the guardian angel of the Israelites, defending them against the angels of the other peoples.

In the New Testament Gospel of Luke, Gabriel appears to Zechariah foretelling the birth of John the Baptist. Gabriel later appears to Mary, mother of Jesus to announce that she would conceive and bear a son (i.e., Jesus) via virgin birth. Many branches of Christianity—including Eastern Orthodoxy, the Catholic Church, Lutheranism, and Anglicanism—revere Gabriel as a saint.

Islam regards Gabriel as an archangel sent by God to various prophets, including Muhammad. The first five verses of the Al-Alaq, the 96th chapter of the Quran, are believed by Muslims to have been the first verses of the revelations given by Gabriel to Muhammad. He is associated with communication.

entities.description:
Gandoca was a Costa Rican fisherman who was the cousin of Diego, although he identified him as 'Dieguito.'

Howard King brought Gandoca to meet Lewis Dodgson and George Baselton and he and King told the two he has a boat. He also identified Richard Levine when Dodgson showed him a picture and told Dodgson when Levine came. Gandoca was initially reluctant to sail to Isla Sorna due to the weather, however, when shown five thousand in unspecified currency he agreed to take the trio. Later, Sarah Harding boarded his fishing boat when Dodgson cunningly invited her to join them. Gandoca was most likely in the returning fishing boat which King spotted and it initially did not leave even with the incoming storm. However, King later spotted them leaving.

entities.name: Geba
entities.description:
Geba possesses a brownish-black hide with orange stripes from his neck to the tip of his tail. Half of his face is orange and the other half and his mouth is blackish-brown. He has a couple of orange patches on his legs.

Geba, a loving and devoted dinosaur, shares a strong bond with Zayna, his caretaker, forged through time and care. He exhibits playful tendencies, often sneaking up and following her, revealing a lighthearted and affectionate nature.

Geba displays a fascination with water, exemplified by his eager attempt to drink from a bucket held over Zayna's head. He curiously mouthing to access to the water, before turning to his own water container. Additionally, Geba shows interest in small buckets containing food, prompting Zayna to carefully ensure he doesn't knock them over.

Geba’s curiosity extends to new individuals, as evidenced by his enthusiastic participation in a impromptu race with Yasmina Fadoula, where he eagerly runs alongside this new person, showcasing his friendly and adventurous nature.

entities.name: Elizabeth Gelman
entities.description:
Dr. Elizabeth Gelman was the head of research at the San Diego Zoo and a friend of Dr. Ian Malcolm in .

Gelman was first mentioned in by Malcolm after he told his assistant Beverly told call her as he wanted Gelman to examine the contents of the strange animal Richard Levine sent him. She was head of research at the San Diego Zoo and examined gorillas, koala bears and a particular snow leopard named Dorje which bit Malcolm's hand after he attempt to pet it. She examined the content of the strange animal, first telling Malcolm her colleagues heard of the "unknown animals showing up in Costa Rica."

Under a light and slide projector she showed him that it was in a "state of very advanced necrosis" and that a close exanimation first indication that it was some kind of lizard. One cell showed it was a chameleon and male. The subcutaneous layers were surrounded by smooth muscle fibers, not characteristic of any lizard and the whole side indicated it was not one. There were chromatophores, or pigment-bearing cells, indicating it's skin could change color. Both her and Malcolm could not figure out what animal it was. However, she told him it was from a 'Site B' - Malcolm forgot to check the specimen which had a tag reading that. Gelman surmized that the tag was placed on the creature when it was young. She further noted it was exposed to some acid and Malcolm wondered if it was volcanic fumes. She further identified it as a radio tag and remarked somebody is rearing these strange animals and gets no answer from him. As he left, she gave him two last pieces of information: there was a foreign cell on the specimen, indicating the animal was in some fight. The section information was that "there were signs of chronic vasoconstriction in the arterial vessels," meaning it lived in a strainous environment. It was this information from the tag which led Malcolm to believe Levine was correct; that dinosaurs existed somewhere again.

entities.name: Gia
entities.description:
Gia is a supporting character in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. She is Ben Pincus' girlfriend and lives in Northern Italy.

Paleontology student Gia demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a passion for dinosaurs. Her expertise is evident when she discusses dinosaur species with Ben, demonstrating her extensive knowledge and analytical skills. She also demonstrates her ingenuity by identifying the Maltese catacombs in a video message, contributing to the group's mission.

Gia is generous and caring, especially in her relationship with Ben and his friends. She welcomes the Nublar Six into her home, offering them shelter and support despite her grandmother Nonna's initial disapproval. Her willingness to lend her car and join the group in their quest for Bumpy's egg demonstrates her selflessness and dedication to others. Her strength and generosity reveal a more mature side of Ben, a testament to his positive influence.

Gia is in personal conflict with her Nonna, who disapproves of dinosaurs out of superstition. Despite this, Gia remains committed to her studies, even if it requires her to hide her true passion (paleontology) by pretending to study art history. Her ability to finally admit her mistakes to Nonna and reconcile with her is a testament to her emotional strength and independence.

entities.name: Gordon
entities.description:
Gordon is a male Compsognathus who appears in the second season of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

Gordon looks like a normal Compsognathus, except his right foot is amputated and has a bandage. Plus he has an Elizabethan collar.

Gordon, the Compsognathus, was caught in a wire, resulting in him losing his right foot. DPW workers Ronnie and Darius were sent to retrieve him and he was brought back to Ronnie's house, now with a bandage on his right leg and an Elizabethan collar.

He was seen first in a cage outside of Ronnie's house, near the balcony, where Brooklynn gives him a bowl of food to which he eats as the girl watches. Later, when corrupted DPW member Jared enters the house and with Brooklynn tries to hide from him, she tries to hide in the balcony, but unwittingly attracted the attention of Gordon, to which she replied with a shush. When Jared enters the the balcony after hearing the noise, he sees nothing but Gordon and leaves. Gordon is still at Ronnie's house when she returned.

entities.name: Gray Mitchell
entities.description:
Gray Mitchell is the younger brother of Zach, as well as the son of Karen and Scott and the younger nephew of Claire Dearing. He is a precocious young boy who has a great interest in dinosaurs. In 2015, he and his elder brother visited Jurassic World and was involved in much of the events of the incident. Gray is portrayed by American actor Ty Simpkins in Jurassic World.

Gray is very intelligent and has a variety of scientific interests, especially dinosaurs. As was typical of kids his age, he was exceedingly hyper, impatient and easily excited by dinosaurs, which was a cause of annoyance for his older brother. He was also quite sensitive, as he burst into tears at the thought of his parents divorce and his brother's indifferent attitude. Though obviously frightened by his ordeal on the island, Gray was also quite brave as he stunned a raptor with a cattle prod with little assistance.

After boarding an airplane, Gray and Zach boarded a ferry boat to Masrani Global Corporation's famous dinosaur theme park Jurassic World, whose aunt, Claire Dearing, was Senior Assets Manager for. They were supervised by Claire's personal assistant Zara, as Claire was too busy to spend time with her nephews. While there, they got to see many of Jurassic World's attractions, including the Mosasaurus Feeding Show, Underwater Observatory, and the T. rex Kingdom. On the way, in the Monorail, Gray broke down in tears at his parents' impending divorce but was told to grow up by an annoyed and unsympathetic Zach. As he looked out the window, he saw two Asset Containment Unit vehicles driving in the valley below, but was unaware of their true purpose.

Gray and Zach ignored an order for the ride to return and ventured into the Restricted Area, though Gray was reluctant. As they viewed a herd of four Ankylosaurus, Gray suddenly saw a fifth dinosaur reflected in the glass, one with white scales, spikes, razor sharp teeth, and bloody red eyes. This was the Indominus rex, the park's first genetically-modified hybrid which had escaped her paddock. The two nervously looked behind them and saw the creature, which let out a blood-curdling roar and kicked Gray and his brother's vehicle as if it was a soccer ball between two Ankylosaurus who were also fleeing from the hybrid. Because they got too close to the Ankylosaurus, one of the Ankylosaurus swung its clubbed tail at the spherical vehicle, leaving it crippled. Upside down, Gray watched in horror as the Ankylosaurus fought the hybrid before it was flipped over. Gray looked away in disgust as the hybrid grabbed and twisted the Ankylosaurus's neck and devoured it.

entities.name: Harold Greenwood
entities.description:
"I first met Harold Greenwood in 1992, he was a, an American. Introduced to me as a former Green Beret. He asked a number of questions about the disposition of the InGen Technology. Harry claimed to be a friend of my former son-in-law, I liked him. He was confident, dashing. Greenwood carried some sort of an electronic device which we were told he built himself, based on plans he found on the internet"

Hidden inside the Dam on the Trespasser version of Isla Sorna, a skeleton of Harold Greenwood can be found. The deceased starved while hiding from Velociraptors after he'd managed to crawl into the dam, losing blood.

Harold Greenwood would've played a bigger part of the cut level Plains where, according to a 1997 "walkthrough," is where Anne would hunt down a T. rex to get a battery for the electronic device found at Greenwood's body.

entities.name: Greg
entities.description:
Greg was a man camping out at Big Rock National Park. He owned a crossbow, which he taught Kadasha how to use, much to her father Dennis' displeasure.

When a group of Nasutoceratops invaded the group's campsite, Greg hid in his camper van. This ended up saving his life when a One-Eyed Allosaurus appeared and attacked the Nasutoceratops family, then turned its wrath on the trailer with Dennis' family inside. But thanks to Greg teaching Kadasha how to use his crossbow, she was able to retrieve it and use it to drive the Allosaurus away. Greg was last seen timidly emerging from his camper to survey the damage.

entities.name: Grim
entities.description:
Grim was a female Baryonyx, and one of the tertiary antagonists in the second season of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, alongside her siblings.

Grim is a Baryonyx of green complexion with red patches surrounding both eyes. She and another Baryonyx that was seen in The Drop are the only known Baryonyx individuals to have this coloration.

Grim cared deeply for her packmates Chaos and Limbo, even abandoning a hunt when she heard Chaos and Limbo squabbling with each other.

Grim was one of the Baryonyx kept at Jurassic World, where she formed a close bond with other members of her species Chaos and Limbo. At some point Grim was taken to a medical center on the island, eventually being abandoned there when the Jurassic World Incident forced the island to be abandoned. Within days, Limbo and Chaos broke out of their habitat and searched for Grim, bringing them to the facility as park survivors Brooklynn, Darius Bowman, and Sammy Gutierrez had found the camp. While Chaos attempted to free their sibling, Limbo attacked the humans, who freed a herd of Stegosaurus in defense. The herd confronted Limbo and forced Chaos to back him up. The pair attempted to scare off the herbivores, but were unable to until Darius freed Grim, and together the pack scared off the herd. After this encounter, Sammy dubbed each Baryonyx with their names.

entities.name: Gunnar Eversoll
entities.description:
Gunnar Eversoll was an black market auctioneer who collaborated with Eli Mills to sell the rescued dinosaurs from Isla Nublar's erupting volcano to the highest bidder during an auction at Lockwood Manor. He serves as a supporting antagonist of Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.

Gunnar Eversoll was portrayed by English actor Toby Jones.

Not much is known about Gunnar Eversoll's origins other than his status as an auctioneer, presumably fine with working with criminal elements from around the globe. At some point prior to Fallen Kingdom, Eversoll was contacted by Eli Mills in order to set up selling the last remaining dinosaurs on Isla Nublar to willing buyers at Lockwood Manor. Though he seemingly was unimpressed by the matter.

Gunnar Eversoll was the host of an auction in Lockwood Manor to sell the dinosaurs, except Blue. He is an accomplished auctioneer who is unconcerned with morals or ethics regarding what he sells, merely caring about the profits. Indeed, his arrogance nearly makes him call the whole thing off when Eli Mills admits that the dinosaurs he's supposed to be selling have yet to arrive, but he is convinced to stay when Mills shows him a hologram of the new hybrid. He is shown selling off an Ankylosaurus, a juvenile Allosaurus, a Baryonyx, a Stegosaurus, and the Indoraptor to numerous buyers.

entities.name: Gustavus
entities.description:
Dr. Gustavus is a geneticist who works for InGen.

Dr. Gustavus is accredited as one of the top geneticists in the world. InGen had allegedly paid top dollar to get his employment at Jurassic Park, even going so far as to fire employees who disrupt his work (something that his coworkers are well aware of and thus allow him to do what he pleases, regardless of it being company protocol).

Meanwhile to the events of the film, InGen scientists, Derrick Hoyle and Abby Nakajima, stumble upon the scientist, as he’s secretly loading away on fertilized eggs off somewhere. When asked about this by Derrick, Gustavus quickly retaliates by threatening the man’s job before driving off. Abby and Derrick would trail him back to a private cliffside laboratory. In which they find a stack of small privately cloned dinosaurs, that Gustavus had been creating behind Hammond’s back, including a small Triceratops, Avimimus, and a Leaellynasaura named Gideon with almost primate level intelligence.

Gustavus would attempt to kill the two scientists by holding them at gunpoint and cover up their deaths as an accident regarding the carnivores. Before he attempted to shoot them, however, Gustavus reveals that he took the job at Jurassic Park in order to genetically clone dinosaurs to create a superior race to humans. This, however, is quickly retorted by Abby and Derrick who manage to escape.

entities.description:
Dr. Martin "Marty" Gutierrez is an American biologist living in Costa Rica who played minor yet important supporting roles in both novels. He likes to wear ing or Khaki and has a beard. He is arguably Richard Levine's best friend, Dr. Cruz is also a friend of his.

Marty Gutierrez was born in 1960 in the United States of America, likely somewhere in the South. Gutierrez received his doctorate in herpetology (the study of reptiles) at the . He was appointed as field researcher at the in Costa Rica and worked on behalf of the Costa Rican government.

At some point he befriended Richard Levine, a wealthy dinosaur and paleontology fanatic. He was also familiar with Dr. Cruz.

Dr. Gutierrez is summoned by Dr. Cruz to Puntarenas to observe his patient, Tina Bowman, who was attacked by a unknown species of lizard. From the description and a drawing Gutierrez concludes that the lizard has to be a Basiliscus amoratus. Although Tina was sure the lizard stood on two legs and its feet had three toes, Gutierrez was certain this wasn't the case.

entities.name: Sammy Gutierrez
entities.description:
Sammy was born sometime in 2001, the daughter of Mr. Gutierrez and an unknown mother, the sister of unknown siblings, and the granddaughter of unknown grandparents.

Sammy's family owns a ranch in Texas that supplies meat for the carnivores in Jurassic World. At an undisclosed time in the past, the ranch ran into trouble and her parents borrowed money from running Mantah Corp. The family was blackmailed by Kash D. Langford into sending her daughter Sammy as a spy in Jurassic World, to steal genetic samples from the dinosaurs for illicit use by the company, or everything they had worked for over the years would be taken away from them. Her parents rejected her request, but Sammy, fearful that her family would lose the ranch, chose to secretly accept her request and offered to act as a spy for the company after signing up for Camp Cretaceous.

Sammy arrived at Isla Nublar at the Ferry Landing along with the other campers, and were greeted by Dave and Roxie. After the introductions, the campers are taken to Camp Cretaceous. Sammy meets Brooklynn and greets her, telling her that she is one of her Brooklanders and states that she attended Camp Cretaceous because her family provides the meat that feeds the carnivores. Arriving at camp, Sammy looks on in awe and remarks that the camp is almost as big as her family's ranch. Later that early evening, all the campers, including Sammy, ride the zipline over a herd of dinosaurs.

On the first day of camp, she visits the Genetics Lab with the others, where they are given a tour of the facilities. Sent by Mantah Corp as a spy, Sammy takes advantage of this and sneaks into Dr. Wu's office and steals important information from his computer and files on a flash drive. Trying to sneak out, she runs into Brooklynn and rejoins the group just after Bumpy's birth. Shortly after they are abruptly expelled by Wu, who is furious that Brooklynn broke into his office. During the night, Sammy hands the USB drive to a Mantah Corp drone that lands in a forest clearing, and takes off directly to Mantah Corp Island.

entities.name: Katashi Hamada
entities.description:
Katashi Hamada was a commander of InGen Security Division's Asset Containment Unit.

Before joining the InGen Security Division, Hamada was a SWAT team leader.

Hamada and his team were called to stop Jurassic World's remaining Indominus rex who had escaped her paddock, along with another team led by Austin. As the ACU soldiers were tracking the Indominus, they discovered that the genetically modified theropod had clawed out its tracking implant. Katashi looked up, and noticed the blood dripping off the trees, which turned out to be blood from the leaves above. The branches and leaves began shaking and snapping, and soon the dinosaur revealed itself to be camouflaging nearby, much to the shock and horror of the other troopers. Katashi tried to run away, but he was snatched up by the dinosaur. The others shocked the dinosaur with tazer rifles and stun rods, though inadvertently electrocuting Hamada as well. The dinosaur dropped Katashi, who attempted to crawl away, but the I. Rex stepped on him, crushing and killing him.

His death may be a reference to , where the character Carter trips and falls into a puddle, before he is crushed and killed under the foot of the Tyrannosaur Doe.

entities.description:
Hampton was an InGen security officer in San Diego.

Peter Ludlow instructed Hampton to admit Ian Malcolm and Sarah Harding to the InGen docks after Jerry denied them entrance. Following the crash of the S.S. Venture and the escape of the Tyrannosaur Buck, it was Hampton who explained to Ian and Sarah what had happened following the ship's departure from Isla Sorna, involving the crew administering amphetamines to the dinosaur after it went into arrest.

Hampton himself never appears in LEGO Jurassic World but numerous InGen guards are modeled on his appearance.

entities.name: Gerry Harding
entities.description:
Dr. Gerry Harding is the Chief Veterinarian of Jurassic Park. He is a minor character in Jurassic Park, being portrayed by the film's producer Gerald R. Molen. Molen was 57 at the time and had graying hair.

In the 1993 film, he was first met by the endorsment team while tending to a sick Triceratops that had been suffering from an unknown illness every six weeks. According to surrounding material (i.e. Jurassic Park: The Game, and The Lost World) has been married multiple times and has two daughters, Jessica and Sarah Harding.

In , he was seen treating a Triceratops suffering from a strange disease. He and Ellie would look into the dinosaur's health, with Ellie noting the dinosaur's dialated pupils. Later, he drove Ellie back to the Visitor Center in his Gas-powered Jeep. After that, he left for the last boat to the mainland.

It was stated in the website that apparently Harding had been suspicious of Nedry and had at some point found he was responsible for the theft of 15 embryos.Ross S. (June 11, 2018). entities.name: Jessica Harding
entities.description:
Jessica Marie "Jess" Harding is one of Jurassic Park's veterinarian and Dr. Gerry Harding's daughters. Along with her father, Jess was left behind on Isla Nublar; during the Incident. She was voiced by Heather Hudson.

Jess can be described as a stereotypical rebellious teenager. She is 14 years old; has been involved in behavior she knows is wrong, and is angry at her parents because of their divorce and how it impacts her life. She is noted to have low marks at school in some classes but under pressure is able to recall useful information showing she's not stupid just under pressure.

Her behavior suggests Jess is a fundamentally decent person acting out because of unprocessed problems at home with her parents recent divorce and stress she doesn't know how to cope with as a result. Her misdeeds are small and her emotions strong.

Born in 1978. Jess's early life is unknown, but her father states that when she was younger she used to visit him when he worked in the San Diego Zoo.

entities.description:
Dr. Sarah Harding is an animal behaviorist who specialized in which also included the dinosaurs. In both canons, she joined the Research Team led by Ian Malcolm, with whom she has a relationship in the film, to Isla Sorna.

Sarah is confirmed to be the daughter of Dr. Gerry Harding in the film canon, and has a half-sister named Jess Harding, both of whom were involved in the Jurassic Park Incident and its aftermath, her relationship with Gerry Harding is only implied in The Lost World.

In The Lost World: Jurassic Park (film), Sarah serves as the deuteragonist.

In , Sarah had joined a small team of researchers on Isla Sorna on John Hammond's request. She displayed an array of knowledge in both living animals, having researched at the San Diego Zoo and dinosaurs, understanding the anatomy of the leg muscles of the infant Tyrannosaur, she successfully treated. Sarah was joined later in the expedition by Ian Malcolm; with; who she had an ongoing relationship and his other team members as soon as they could. Despite their rivalry, Sarah had endured Burke's behavior and even tried to save Burke; when he was panicked; into the Tyrannosaur's mouth after he saw a snake slithering; into his shirt. The Tyrannosaurs stalked the group for a time; because Sarah's jacket was covered in blood from; when her and Nick Van Owen set the infant's leg. Sarah and Malcolm survive the expedition.

entities.description:
The helicopter co-pilot was a mercenary who was affiliated with Zora Bennett. He and the rest of the crew were contracted by Zora to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert to rescue her. However, as they headed to the land, the Distortus rex grabbed the helicopter and killed all three aboard. He appeared to be rigorous and competent in his work, flying only for the two minutes that Zora had ordered.

In 2027, Zora hired him and the pilot to monitor the Essex's radio frequency in case it goes silent for 24 hours on their mission. If so, they would fly over the abandoned InGen village complex at sunset on the second night. The helipad at this location was chosen as the pickup spot because it would allow the helicopter to hover for two minutes. If no one showed up, they would leave.

entities.description:
The helicopter pilot was a mercenary who was affiliated with Zora Bennett. She and the rest of the crew were contracted by Zora to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert to rescue her. She appeared to be rigorous and competent in her work, flying only for the two minutes that Zora had ordered.

In 2027, Zora hired her and the co-pilot to monitor the Essex's radio frequency in case it goes silent for 24 hours on their mission. If so, they would fly over the abandoned InGen village complex at sunset on the second night. The helipad at this location was chosen as the pickup spot because it would allow the helicopter to hover for two minutes. If no one showed up, they would leave.

After Zora and her team finished their mission, they met at the InGen complex. However, they were attacked by the Mutadons. While hiding in an abandoned lab, Duncan Kincaid and Dr. Loomis spotted the helicopter hovering over the island. He ran to fire a flare to get the helicopter's attention, but the Distortus rex destroyed it.

entities.name: Ben Hildebrand
entities.description:
Benjamin "Ben" Hildebrand was the late boyfriend of Amanda Kirby following her divorcement with Paul Kirby, and served as a father figure of sorts to her son Eric Kirby.

Intending to bond with Eric, Ben organized an illegal parasailing tour of Isla Sorna run by Enrique Cardoso. But, due to a freak accident, the boat had crashed, and Ben and Eric were forced to detach well parachuting, becoming stranded on the island; resulting in Ben being killed at some point during this ordeal, leaving Eric to fend for himself in the hostile environment until help had arrived.

At some point, following Amanda Kirby's divorce from her husband Paul, she and Ben met and struck up a romance. He also had bonded, with her son, Eric and became a father-figure of sorts to him.

At some point, in an attempt to further bond with Eric, Ben had offered to take him on an illicit parasailing tour of Isla Sorna, despite knowing full well that the island was strictly off-limits to human exploration. Although well aware of the potential ramifications of the tour, both legal and otherwise, Ben was able to obtain Amanda's permission to take her son on the trip as he had planned, although, whether Amanda knew of the illegal ramifications of the tour, is unknown.

entities.name: Vic Hoskins
entities.description:
Victor "Vic" Hoskins was a major antagonist of Jurassic World. He was the leader of Jurassic World's private security force. Under his leadership, InGen developed advanced security measures that helped to protect the visitors from the dinosaurs and could also be used in wars. He met his end when the Velociraptor Delta cornered him in one of the Innovation Center's labs and failed to listen to his hand signals, instead choosing to rip him to shreds.

He served as one of the two main antagonists of Jurassic World (alongside the Indominus rex), an unseen antagonist of the Netflix spin-off Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous (specifically as an unseen antagonist of Season 1 and a posthumous antagonist of the following seasons), and a posthumous antagonist of both Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom and Jurassic World: Dominion.

Vic Hoskins once owned a stray wolf pup, which attacked his wife when she tried to stab him. He never had it euthanized.

Hoskins joined the InGen Security Division sometime before 2001 as a security contractor. When the three Pteranodons that had escaped the Isla Sorna Aviary at the end of the Isla Sorna Incident of 2001 reached Canada, Hoskins oversaw the "clean up" of the adult Pteranodons.

entities.name: Hunter Moore
entities.description:
Hunter Edward Moore (born March 9, 1986) is an American convicted criminal from Sacramento, California. Rolling Stone called him "the most hated man on the Internet." In 2010, he created the revenge porn website Is Anyone Up? which allowed users to post sexually explicit photos of people online without their consent, often accompanied by personal information such as their names and addresses. He refused to take down pictures on request. Moore called himself "a professional life ruiner" and compared himself to Charles Manson. The website was up for 16 months, during which Moore stated several times he was protected by the same laws that protect Facebook. Moore also paid a hacker to break into email accounts of victims and steal private photos to post.

The FBI started an investigation on Moore in 2012 after receiving evidence from Charlotte Laws, the mother of one of the victims. The site was closed in April 2012 and sold to an anti-bullying group. In February 2015, Moore pleaded guilty to felony charges for aggravated identity theft and aiding and abetting in the unauthorized access of a computer. In November 2015, Moore was sentenced to two years and six months in prison, a $2,000 fine, and $145.70 in restitution. He was released from prison in May 2017.

In 2022, Netflix released The Most Hated Man on the Internet, a docuseries about Moore. Although Moore initially agreed to take part in the series, he then declined. The series reached No. 3 on the Netflix top 10.

The Indominus rex twins were two baby Indominus rex that appeared as minor antagonists in the LEGO special LEGO Jurassic World: Double Trouble.

The twins share an identical body shape but with different skin tones. One individual is white with grey markings while the second individual is a dark grey with lighter gray markings. Both twins have deep red eyes.

The white individual is likely inspired by the design of the Indominus rex as it appears in the LEGO Jurassic World video game and the 2015 set 75919 Indominus rex Breakout , while the grey individual is likely inspired by the design of the Indominus rex in the 2020 LEGO set 75941 Indominus Rex vs. Ankylosaurus.

entities.name: Indominus rex's sibling
entities.description:
A second sibling Indominus rex was cloned by Dr. Henry Wu for Jurassic World. However, prior to her debut, she was killed and cannibalized by her sister. Neither Indominus is known to have been given any form of name or designation, and were most likely identified solely by specimen numbers. As only one survived, distinguishing between the two is not necessary in most cases.

Both Indominus hatched within the same day at some point after 2012 on Isla Nublar. This followed roughly three years of experimentation after their creation was authorized on April 4, 2012 by Masrani Global Corporation CEO Simon Masrani. The species development took place in the Hammond Creation Laboratory. After hatching, each one was fitted with a subdermal RFID tracking implant which would constantly update the Jurassic World computer network with the dinosaurs’ locations and biometrics. The implants were placed in the animals’ backs, just above the left shoulder in at least one of them. The Indominus were intended to live in a paddock with physical walls and therefore would not have been affected by the park’s invisible fencing system, but unlike other animals where this was the case, the Indominus tracking implants were programmed to shock them if they came too close to other park attractions. This was presumably an additional security measure. At an unknown point prior to November 2015, one of the Indominus cannibalized the other. This information was not relayed to Simon Masrani, who had not yet seen the animals in person.

The Indominus rex hatched out of her egg, alongside her sibling.

entities.name: Iris Carroll
entities.description:
Iris Carroll is an English former housekeeper of the Lockwood Manor, the former nanny of Maisie Lockwood and the keeper of all the family's secrets. She was a longtime employee of Sir Benjamin Lockwood and served that role right until his death.

Iris served as the housekeeper for the Lockwood Family for many years. The exact date of when she was hired is not known but she has worked for Sir Benjamin long enough to raise both his daughter and "granddaughter" from their respective births.

Lockwood's daughter, Charlotte, was raised by Iris at Lockwood Manor. At one point, the two took a photo together which became a memento of Sir Benjamin. Iris was successful in raising Charlotte from childhood to adulthood and saw her marry an unnamed man for a husband. However, Iris thought tragedy struck when in the mid 1990s, Charlotte and her husband were killed in a "car accident." The event devastated Sir Benjamin who (supposedly) in his grief, began to try and bring his daughter "back" through cloning. Iris helped keep Sir Benjamin's secrets over the matter and years later in 2009, Lockwood's "granddaughter" Maisie Lockwood was born.

Iris helped Sir Benjamin in raising his "grandchild" as she knew the original best, understood her interests and sense of humor. Iris also subtlety helped the new child be closer to her original through teaching her a "Queen's English" accent. Another reason for her aid in helping raising Maisie was Sir Benjamin's declining health in his older age which left him unable to walk.

entities.name: Jack
entities.description:
Jack is a blue-and-yellow macaw (Ara ararauna) owned by the Degler family during the events of Jurassic Park III.

Not much is known about Jack's personality, as he does not have any lines in the film. In a scrapped line from the film, Jack curses at a statement made by Dr. Alan Grant. This could suggest that Jack is quite a rude bird, although this may also be because either Ellie or Mark Degler had taught the bird to say such a phrase.

Jack is a macaw of blue-and-yellow coloring. His eyes are a greyish-green color, and he possesses a sharp, black beak. His age is unknown, although a macaw with grey eyes is typically quite young.

Jack has a large cage, situated in the Degler family's dining room, with a reasonably large door and a lock on the left side of the opening. The cage has a toy hanging in the corner with a small bell attached to it. When Alan walks towards the dining table, another toy can be seen on the opposite side of the cage, also with a small bell attached. Jack also seems to be perched on something, although this object is never seen.

entities.name: Daniel Jackson
entities.description:
Deputy Daniel Jackson was a police officer of a small unincorporated town somewhere in Southern California. He was a Native American of unknown heritage and served alongside Sheriff Will Tobias. Sometime in 2011, Jackson aided Will in an investigation with the FBI and Paleontologists to stop murderous Pteranodon from terrorizing their region. After all the animals were killed and the death of Sheriff Tobias, Jackson gained the position of Sheriff of the community.

Daniel Jackson serves as one of the protagonists of the IDW Publishing comic book series Jurassic Park: The Devils in the Desert.

Daniel "Dan" Jackson was a Native American of unknown heritage greatly familiar with the desert regions of Southern California. He had three sons, one of whom was named Luke. He taught his sons the skills of tracking in the desert as his ancestors likely had before him. Jackson became a Deputy of the unincorporated town under Sheriff Will Tobias at some point prior to 2011. The two were good friends and worked well together.

Deputy Jackson was already at the station when Tyler Franklin came on horseback for Sheriff Tobias' help. When Liz the secretary informed Jackson that it Tyler mentioned fifteen cattle mutilations, Jackson noted that it was too early in the season for coyote or wolves to be coming from the foothills. Jackson took Tyler's horse back to his home while Tyler brought Tobias to where his dad was. Jackson reunited with Tobias & Tyler at the Franklin homestead where he informed Jackson that the situation was more than just cattle mutilations. After sending Sara Franklin and her son Tyler to town to stay with her parents, Jackson asked Will about his history with Sara. Will told him about their history before arriving at the site.

James McClure is the lead network engineer of Mascom.

James was involved in the construction of Masrani Global Corporation's Jurassic World. He isolated an anomaly in Jurassic World's system in 2004. After he felt it was "watertight" he sent an email to an undisclosed recipient telling the recipient what he had accomplished and that he would give Vic Hoskins a call to see if there was anything that needed to be updated.

By 2014, he was the lead network engineer of Mascom.

entities.name: Ed James
entities.description:
He was hired by Lewis Dodgson to follow around the survivors of Isla Nublar in order to get more information about Site B, being paid $500 a day. He apparently did not enjoy his job very much, and found it not worth his payment. During his work, he quickly grew a clear five-o'clock-shadow. He hated following scientists around, because he thought that it was very boring. For example, that he once went to one of Dr. Ellie Sattler's lectures about prehistoric pollen and the Campanian-Maastrichtian Boundary. He is shown to be very afraid of Lewis Dodgson, even going so far as fearing that he will be killed by Dodgson. However, he later becomes reassured when he realizes that George Baselton is with Dodgson and can keep him at bay. James did not travel to Isla Sorna.

Ed James, like many novel characters, was written out of the movie. However, a few of his personalities were transferred to a few other characters, most notably Peter Ludlow. Like him, Ludlow was cowardly, conniving, and not very intelligent.

entities.description:
Soyona Santos's Dinosaur Trafficking Ring}} Jared was a minor antagonist in the first season of Jurassic World: Chaos Theory who catches dinosaurs alongside his partner Jensen in order to deliver the animals to Soyona Santos. He was killed by a Becklespinax.

Jared and Jensen arrived at the Dinosaur Free Zone and began firing at Ben, Sammy, and Yasmina, popping their tires to prevent them from escaping the Becklespinax.

Jared and Jensen were putting a Becklespinax Jared shot it with a tranquilizer dart causing it to collapse shortly after entering the container.

They zapped the Becklespinax multiple times before being scolded by Dudley Cabrera. He was later patrolling near the containers where Sammy and Yaz revealed they were there, he chased after them giving Ben an opportunity to free Bumpy. He began firing at them in an attempt to stop them. After Yaz and Sammy stole a vehicle, he got into another vehicle and pursued them into the enclosure where multiple Dinosaurs were being held. Yaz took a sharp turn near a water source, Jared wasn't able to turn fast enough causing him to go into the water. He exited his vehicle with a tranq gun and was attacked by a Becklespinax, killing him. with parasaurolophus, stegosaurus and many other herbivorous dinosaurs watching Jared get killed.

entities.name: Jeffrey
entities.description:
Jeffrey is an employee at Biosyn Research Facility in the Dolomites.

When Owen Grady, Claire Dearing and Kayla Watts enter Biosyn's airspace, Jeffrey tells Lewis Dodgson that Santos told him they are Maisie's parents, and he is ordered by Dodgson to shut off the ADS. This led the Quetzalcoatlus to attack their plane and crash it at the dam.

Jeffrey later shows Dodgson security camera footage of Dr. Ellie Sattler and Alan Grant getting a DNA sample of a locust from the Biosyn restricted lab. When asked where they are, he tells Dodgson they are in a hyperloop train on their way to the airfield. Dodgson shuts it down, thus making the train stop in the Amber Mines. Jeffrey later abandons Dodgson along with the other employees after realizing just how far Dodgson's ambitions have pushed him.

entities.description:
Jerry was a welder who worked for Dr. Jack Thorne at Thorne Mobile Field Systems.

When Arby Benton and Kelly Curtis went to Thorne Mobile Field Systems to find Doc Thorne, Doc Thorne yelled at Jerry to "balance the struts on both sides (of the RV trailer)" and told him to remember the crash rests. Thorne further scolded Jerry for "not following the plans" and being "brain dead" to which Jerry apologized. Thorne nevertheless shouted back he didn't need an apology just someone to be correct. Jerry continued to say they were overbuilt while Thorne countered saying he was the designer not Jerry. Jerry wasn't as careful as his fellow worker Henry.
