entities.name: Jones
entities.description:
Jones was a poacher tracking Blue in Gibson Peak, California following the Dinosaur Outbreak. He and his partner, McNally sought to bag the raptor following it's disruption of ranching operations in the area.

Jones and his partner McNally were hired by local ranchers in the Gibson Peak area to deal with the raptor, Blue who had been killing livestock and destroying property. They were expected to have completed the job by friday. While in the woods they were observed by Maisie Lockwood and Violet Moody who overheard them discussing their plans. McNally convinced Jones to without their bosses knowledge kill the two Triceratops they sighted earlier and sell their horns on the market as well as bag Blue for him and the ranchers. Following this agreement they went back to their motel for an equipment check then head out the following morning.

Coming back the next day they were attacked by Maisie from a treehouse. McNally in response ordered Jones to pursue the triceratops calls they heard while he pursued Maisie. Jones pursued the calls only to discover Violet Moody. While interrogating her Blue jumped out of the bushes and targeted him, perceiving him as the threat. While fleeing he was caught in one of the snares set up by the children and stayed snared until Sheriff Wragg, Owen and Claire arrived. Once let down he taunted Owen before being taken away by the Sheriff.

Throughout the book there are several hints that Jones and McNally work for a larger organization rather than being independent poachers. During their first conversation they mention a "facility" and a "boss" who is interested in capturing Blue. They're also well aware of Owen, Claire and Maisie's identities, Jones even going so far as to taunt them about it. The organization they work for is unknown but due to the interest in Blue and Maisie one could reasonably assume they work for Biosyn. This tracks due to Lewis Dodgson having several ties to poaching and the black market. entities.name: Josh
entities.description:
Josh was a young Jurassic World employee in charge of the Gyrosphere ride. He let Zach and Gray Mitchell board Gyrosphere 07 before receiving a phone call telling him to close the ride. He then had the unenviable task of informing the other visitors waiting in line that the attraction was closed. As they yelled angrily at him, Josh complained that he "just worked here."

He seemed exceedingly bored with his job and extremely inattentive. He didn't seem used to dealing with angry crowds. When the visitors became irate with him when he told them the ride was closed, Josh was forced to consult an employee guidebook in an effort to figure out how to deal with the situation. Nevertheless, he seemed to grasp the seriousness of the situation and didn't handle it flippantly despite his earlier boredom.

entities.description:
Juan was the pilot of the plane at the start of Jurassic World: Aftermath, alongside his co-pilot Carlos on their mission to Isla Nublar alongside their passengers, Amelia Everett and Sam.

When the plane was attacked by Pteranodons, it crashed somewhere in the abandoned Jurassic World park. Juan survived the crash and called out to Carlos, who did not respond at all and also called to Sam. He seemed to be stuck under something, but was later devoured by the Tyrannosaurus rex, Rexy.

Juan was a serious and devoted pilot, who did not tolerate distractions. He was also a caring individual.

entities.name: Junior
entities.description:
Junior is the son of Buck and Doe featured in the film . Junior gets his name from his toy in Kenner's The Lost World Series 1 who has the codename of "Junior".

As an infant, Junior exhibited the innate behavior of consuming the food left by his parents at the nest during their brief absences for hunting. But this made him vulnerable to capture by hunters who restrained him well he had called out for his parents. Although he had never encountered humans before, he did not display significant fear, only observing the two humans from his position and continuing to eat.

In Junior's distress, he instinctively attempted to defend himself; by trying to bite the human providing treatment for his injured leg.

When faced; with Ludlow, Junior experienced fear and attempted to flee, seeking safety. His father, recognizing the danger, intervened and incapacitated Ludlow by breaking his leg. With his father's encouragement, Junior mustered the confidence to engage in his first hunting attempt, pouncing on the wounded Ludlow and successfully killing him.

entities.name: Karen
entities.description:
Karen was the person who was supposed to be babysitting Kelly Malcolm while Kelly's father, Ian Malcolm, left for Isla Sorna to study and photograph the cloned fauna on the island with fellow Gatherers Sarah Harding, Nick Van Owen and Eddie Carr. Kelly is shown to dislike Karen, and ventures to the island as a stowaway on one of the trailers.

We first hear of Karen when Ian Malcolm tells his daughter that he will be going away and that Kelly will have to stay with someone called Karen. Kelly makes the comment that she does not even know Karen, before Ian makes the point that Kelly has known Karen for ten years. Kelly then calls Karen a (a person who is regarded as being deliberately ignorant or old-fashioned, or a "caveman"), and says that Karen doesn't have Sega. Ian mentions that Kelly's statement was cruel, but had "good word use". Kelly asks why she can't stay with Sarah Harding, and Ian responds with, "Sarah's out of town.". He tells Kelly that Karen is fantastic, and that she plans to go to the movies and go horseback riding with Kelly. As Kelly further argues with her father, Ian is called by Eddie. Karen is not mentioned again at all in the franchise.

Not much is known about Karen's personality, as she does not physically appear on screen. It can be assumed that she is a nice person, as she appeared to have planned fun activities for Kelly, such as horseback riding. She was likely older, as Kelly calls her a troglodyte, a term commonly used to describe someone who is old-fashioned, or a "caveman". Troglodyte can also describe someone who is deliberately ignorant, which may explain why Kelly does not like the person.

entities.name: Roxie Keynes
entities.description:
Roxie Keynes is a supporting character of the Netflix series, Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as a major character of Season 1, a mentioned character of Seasons 2 and 3, and a supporting character of Season 5. Her character is voiced by Jameela Jamil.

Roxie is the head camp counselor at Camp Cretaceous who is joined by Dave. She is seen guiding the kids through activities and making sure everyone is following the rules. She unfortunately has to deal with the campers constantly getting in danger. When the Indominus rex escapes, she and Dave are in waiting to talk to Claire Dearing to discuss the need for more staff at the camp due to the incidents. She wonders why it has been so long, picking the lock of a cabinet revealing sets of ACU walkie-talkies. She hears roaring and screams over the radios, and the life monitors turn red. Realizing something has gone wrong, she and Dave set out to find the kids, tracking their ACU Ipad. They always remain just five minutes behind them and are eventually forced to board the evacuation ferries by a staff member. Roxie and Dave are last seen attempting to turn the boat around to return to Isla Nublar and pick up the campers, but fail to do so. She and Dave most likely made it back to the mainland safely afterwards, and what they did afterwards is unknown.

Roxie's voice is heard over Dave's demo which was found by Kenji, located in the campers old bunks.

Roxie doesn't appear, but Darius reminds Kenji that Dave and Roxie saved them from the Velociraptors, when they encounter Blue.

entities.name: Nick Kilgore
entities.description:
Nick Kilgore was a worker at the Indominus rex Paddock.

Nick Kilgore entered the paddock along with Velociraptor handler Owen Grady and the paddock's supervisor, Nicholas Letting, when the Indominus rex was suspected of climbing out of its paddock. Kilgore, Letting, and Owen inspected the scratch marks that the Indominus made on the wall of the paddock. Supervisor Letting and Owen were discussing the Indominus while Kilgore inspected the scratches when the control room's monitor broadcasted over the radio that the Indominus was actually in the paddock. Letting, Kilgore and Owen ran for the door, but Letting noticed something Owen and Kilgore didn't; the Indominus was hiding in the trees in front of the door, and so he ran to the back exit, where he used his keycode to open the door. Meanwhile, Kilgore and Owen were running for the door, when the I. rex stepped into view. Realizing their error with shock, the two ran for the back exit where Nick went. However, the Indominus grabbed Kilgore with its massive clawed hand. In the control room, the workers listened in horror as Kilgore was ripped apart. When Nicholas Letting looked back over his shoulder as the door opened, he saw the Indominus tear Kilgore's leg from his dead body before devouring his remains, effectively making him the Indominus rex's first victim.

In the junior novelization he is swallowed whole rather than crunched and eaten in multiple bites.

Kilo, nicknamed Baby Kilo, is a baby Velociraptor that could be seen at Universal Studios Singapore. Kilo was first shown off around July 25, 2023.

Kilo could be met at Universal Orlando Singapore, where visitors could greet her. Kilo was carried by a professional handler, and was comfortable being held by them. Kilo enjoys under-chin scratches. She is six months old.

Kilo can be seen at the Raptor Encounter: Generations attraction at Universal Singapore alongside VEL-009 and Blue.

Kilo is bright green with a brown line all the way down her back.

entities.name: Kim
entities.description:
Kim is a female Velociraptor that appears as a supporting antagonist in . A member of Jurassic Park's Velociraptor pack led by The Big One (who might just be one and the same with Kim), Kim entered the Visitor Center Kitchen with fellow raptor Randy during the Isla Nublar Incident of 1993 where the two hunted the siblings Tim and Lex. Kim survived the hunt, albeit stunned, and pursued the kids as well as Drs. Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler through the Control Room and finally the Visitor Center's main entrance hall. Kim was the last of the three raptors to be killed when she pounced on the Rexy, giving the Tyrannosaurus her signature scars that retained all her life, before getting tossed into the Tyrannosaurus skeleton in the main hall.

Kim, as well as Randy, are never named in the film or any related media. Instead, their names originate from a layout and storyboard of the kitchen dated May 11, 1992, where the raptors are given these names come from the actors who used the suits in this scene. "Kim" in particular being assigned to the raptor that is tricked by Lex's reflection.

Kim, like all clone Velociraptors, was created by InGen scientists on Isla Sorna inside a compound. When she was old enough, she was transported to Isla Nublar to serve as an attraction for Jurassic Park. It is unclear if Kim was the raptor named by Robert Muldoon known as the Big One or if she was simply one of the two raptors spared by the Big One.

During the Isla Nublar Incident of 1993, all three of the raptors were freed when John Arnold shut down Jurassic Park's system, corrupted by Whte rbt.obj, in order to reboot it. Kim was known to have entered the Visitor Center of Jurassic Park with fellow raptor Randy and hunted the Murphy siblings inside the center's kitchen, entering the kitchen after Randy called her. After Randy snapped at Kim upon her arrival, the two raptors proceeded to stalk the Murphys inside the kitchen. The two raptors became attracted to a ladle spoon that fell just behind Tim Murphy, nearly revealing him to the carnivores. But Tim's sister who was east of him, Lex, distracted the raptors by grabbing a ladle spoon herself and banging it on the floor. Kim saw Lex's reflection in one of the cabinets and raced toward it. She hit the cabinet so hard she created a dent in the cabinet she rammed into and became briefly stunned.

entities.name: Duncan Kincaid
entities.description:
Unnamed Son (Deceased)}} Duncan Kincaid is a mercenary and covert operations team leader, a friend of Zora Bennett, and a major character in . At some point, Duncan resided in Suriname. He usually works with Zora in war-torn areas.

At some point in Duncan’s life, he met a woman named Amelia with whom he had a son. However, their son died under unknown circumstances, causing Duncan great pain. This led to him and Amelia being apart. During Duncan’s career, he met Zora Bennett who he became good friends with.

At an unknown point, Duncan moved to Paramaribo, Suriname, South America. There, he started smuggling goods via his boat, the Essex, with his crew consisting of LeClerc, Nina and Bobby Atwater. He established the Van Dijk's bar as his base of operations.

In 2027, Duncan is contacted by Martin Krebs, an employee for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering, to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert, a former InGen island, to retrieve blood samples from the three largest dinosaurs. Some time later, Zora, Martin and paleontologist Dr. Henry Loomis arrived at Van Dijk's Bar & Grill to discuss the upcoming mission. Initially, Duncan refuses to take them to the island as his boat is new and he hasn’t pay it off yet. However, Krebs agrees to double Zora’s pay and she would distribute the money between Duncan and his crew. Duncan reluctantly agrees, and the team leave for the island; he tells them their expedition must be discreet as they will be heading to prohibited waters, even though there won’t be much authorities patrolling there since people generally avoid that part of the Carribean Sea.

entities.name: Howard King
entities.description:
Dr. Howard King was an employee of Biosyn. He was a biologist, who lost his credibility when his research on blood-coagulation factors failed and funding removed. He later served as an assistant to Dr. Lewis Dodgson.

King was once a respected biologist, but after his research fell through, his life began to fall apart, and his marriage suffered. Worried about alimony and child support payments, he was approached by Dodgson who took him to a fancy lunch and pitched the offer of joining Biosyn's team. King found Dodgson's unabashed corruption (Dodgson all but admitted to relying on stealing the ideas of others), but as he was desperate for money, he agreed to Dodgson's offer. Years later, his decision seemed to have worked out. He was a respected and well-paid employee of Biosyn, visited his son on weekends, and was engaged to a new woman.

King first appeared bringing fisherman Gandoca to meet Dodgson and Dr. George Baselton. The later brought the trio to Isla Sorna where King was killed, by Velociraptors, which - strangely - ate his candy bar. He was pinned to the ground as he tried to escape by raptors and the raptors crunched his neck bones and decapitated him. He was the only sympathetic member in Dodgson's team, disagreeing with Dodgson's evil act of throwing Sarah Harding overboard and wishing to return the adult Tyrannosaurus egg as he and Dodgson were chased. Eventually he is killed by Velociraptors as the protagonists watch from the high hide.

In the second movie, his character is replaced with a character named Dieter Stark. However, while King is a good person who just happened to work for a villain, Dieter is sadistic and considered by many as the first hate sink in the cinematic universe. In addition, his role as a good person who just happens to work for bad people was reprised by Roland Tembo.

entities.name: Amanda Kirby
entities.description:
Amanda Kirby is the wife of Paul Kirby and former girlfriend of Ben Hildebrand. She, along with Paul, tricked Alan Grant and Billy Brennan to travel to Isla Sorna in order to find their young son, Eric Kirby, who disappeared on the island two months prior along with Ben.

Amanda lived in Enid, Oklahoma and was married to Paul Kirby. They had a son, named Eric, but overtime they grew apart, constantly bickering and being unable to agree on anything. Amanda had eventually divorced Paul just over a year before the events of Jurassic Park III. Sometime afterwards, she had begun dating Ben Hildebrand.

After Eric and Ben's disappearance on Isla Sorna, Amanda had pretended to still be married to her ex-husband, posing as a millionaire thrill-seeker, in order to trick Dr. Alan Grant, unaware that, he had only traveled to Isla Nublar, into accompanying them to Isla Sorna to act as a guide, hoping he would be able to help them find her son. Upon landing on the island, Amanda began using a megaphone to call out to Eric, despite Dr Grant's protests that, this would attract too much attention. He was, proved right, when a Spinosaurus had attacked the group moments later, attracted, by Amanda's shouting. Amanda had narrowly escaped, with the rest of the group. Throughout the film, Amanda had often argued, with Paul and had ignored Alan's advice against, making loud noises, shouting for Eric in her desperation and also screaming in terror, when they encountered predatory dinosaurs. She was distraught, when the group discovered Ben's corpse, especially, when she became tangled in Ben's parachute, causing her to temporarily run off. When Paul had tried to comfort her, Amanda had admitted that, she was more concerned for Eric's welfare than Ben's death, as it, meant that, their son was now all alone on Isla Sorna. She was greatly relieved, when she had discovered that, Eric was alive and they were reunited.

By the end of the ordeal, Amanda began taking Alan's advice more, becoming less impulsive. She also grew closer to her ex-husband again, with the two of them sharing some affectionate moments, including Amanda commenting on Paul losing weight and saying he "looks good" and Amanda embracing Paul after finding Ben's corpse. When confronted by the Raptor pack from who's Billy had stolen the eggs from, the alpha raptor approaches Amanda, believing that, she was the one, who had taken them, this is never fully explained, though one theory is that, the raptors believed Amanda to be the alpha of her own "pack", due to her being the only female. Amanda had managed to stay calm, asking Paul to give her the eggs, which she then returns to the raptors as Eric quietly encourages her on. After the raptors depart, Amanda, along, with the others, tries to warn the man standing on the beach with the megaphone to stop, no doubt remembering her own experience, with, making too much noise. Shortly after, Amanda is rescued from the island, by the navy.

entities.name: Eric Kirby
entities.description:
Eric Kirby is a central character in . He is portrayed by Trevor Morgan.

Eric Kirby was only 12, but showed great intelligence and survival skills for his age, being able to survive on Isla Sorna for 8 weeks alone without being killed by the island's dangerous inhabitants. Some examples include of his skills are using Tyrannosaurus rex urine (remarking to Grant that he didn't "want to know" how Eric collected it) to detour smaller carnivorous dinosaurs like Compsognathus, learning to use gas grenades against the Raptors, and simply acquiring food with prehistoric predators lurking. To avoid being seen while out scavenging supplies, Eric crafted an encompassing cloak covered with leaves for camouflage. Eric also had an interest in dinosaurs, which helped him survive on Isla Sorna.

Eric Kirby is a 12-year-old dinosaur enthusiast who becomes stranded on infamous Isla Sorna after a parasailing accident. He has to survive, completely alone, on the island for eight weeks, using only his intelligence and knowledge as weapons.

Eric had read two of Dr. Alan Grant's books, one from before Isla Nublar and one after the incident, stating that he liked the first better as it conveyed Grant liking dinosaurs. He'd also read Dr. Ian Malcolm's book, but found it to be kind of "preachy" and "high on himself", and talking too much about "chaos".

entities.name: Paul Kirby
entities.description:
Paul Kirby, husband of Amanda Kirby, was the businessman who tricked Dr. Alan Grant onto Isla Sorna to search for his son, Eric Kirby, who disappeared on the island two months prior. Paul lied about being a millionaire businessman who owned the non-existent Kirby Enterprises to convince Alan Grant to join them. He admits later that he owned only a small business called Kirby Paint and Tile Plus at the West Gate Shopping Center in .

Paul first appeared at the Fort Peck Lake dig site and introduced himself to Alan Grant and Billy Brennan as the rich business owner of Kirby Enterprises. He tempted them to join him and his wife at the Hell Creek Bar & Grill for dinner. During dinner, Paul told Alan and Billy that he and his wife were adventurous, having climbed , rafted along the river , visited the and reserved tickets for the first commercial flight to the Moon. Paul offered them one million dollars to join them on an aerial tour over Isla Sorna, and Grant took the offer.

After arriving on Isla Sorna, he tells Grant that it was a mercenary named Cooper who knocked him out. He then tries to relay Alan's orders to stop Amanda yelling into a loudspeaker, but she doesn't realize what he is saying until after they hear a load roar. After that, two other mercenaries named Udesky and Nash return and everyone gets back in the plane. Paul tries to calm Amanda by saying "It's okay, we'll just circle the island." Meanwhile, Cooper is running through the jungle pursued closely by a huge Spinosaurus. As the plane is heading down the runway, and building up speed, Cooper comes through the jungle onto the runway and begs the plane to stop. Suddenly, the Spinosaurus comes through the trees and grabs Cooper. As Cooper is being devoured, the plane clips the sail of Spinosaurus and spirals out of control, crashing into a tree and getting stuck in it.

The gang catches their breath after the terrifying ordeal. Nash asks for Paul's satellite phone, and he gives it to him. Suddenly, the Spinosaurus grabs the nose of the plane and tears it off, leaving the cockpit and cabin exposed. Paul and the others try to get farther back into the plane, but the theropod bites down on Nash's leg and pulls him from the plane. Paul and the others watch in horror as Nash begs them to save him, but before they can do anything, the Spinosaurus drops him onto the ground. He tries to crawl away, but the Spinosaurus steps on his back and eats him. Then, the Spinosaurus grabs the plane and pulls it out of the tree it was lodged in, and it drops it on the ground, trying to make the surviving humans into a meal. With Paul, Billy, Amanda, Alan, and Udesky still inside the plane, it plays a deadly game of kick the can with the wrecked plane. When this fails, it begins to crush the plane, trying to force the gang out. Paul and the others run for it, and they all make it, but the Spinosaurus is hot on their heels.

entities.name: Daniel Kon
entities.description:
Daniel Kon was a major antagonist in the Jurassic Park franchise, serving as the main antagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous and a minor character in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

In Camp Cretaceous, he served as the unseen overarching antagonist of Season 1, one of the two overarching antagonists of Season 2 (alongside Henry Wu), one of the two overarching antagonists and additionally a cameo antagonist of Season 3, the overarching antagonist of Season 4, and the main antagonist of Season 5. In Chaos Theory, he served as a minor character of Season 1 and a posthumous character of Season 2.

He was the father of Kenji Kon and former President of Mantah Corp. After going to prison for 5 years, he lived in a halfway house for a year. He eventually sacrificed himself to save his son’s life before being killed by the Atrociraptor pack.

Daniel is Kenji's father but barely spends time with his son, much to the sadness of the latter. After the fall of Jurassic World, Daniel became the President of Mantah Corp according to his own words, but later mentions and reveals that he gave his former employee Kash D. Langford the order to blackmail the family of Sammy Gutierrez, which happened before the fall of Jurassic World. This probably means that Daniel has been president of Mantah Corp for a much longer period of time than assumed without telling his son, or for that matter, anyone else.

entities.name: Kenji Kon
entities.description:
Kenji was born in 2000 to Daniel Kon, the President of Mantah Corp and owns condos in Jurassic World. Kenji, however had a strained and distant relationship with his father, who was barely ever around for him. It is unknown of Kenji's relationship with his mother. When he was 5, drew a picture of himself, his father two women holding hands, and a mermaid off to the side. It is unknown if Kenji's mom and Mr. Kon are divorced, or if Kenji's mom is dead as he claims. While his father's wealth has made Kenji arrogant and entitled, there is a part of him that is not always happy due to his father not spending time with him and giving him the love he needed.

He also mentioned that boys his age teased him a lot for being rich.

Kenji is a guest of Jurassic World, a constant one and considered a VIP due to his rich dad owning the condominiums built on the island and and claims to know the secret passageways under the island. Kenji arrives at Jurassic World in a helicopter and greets the rest of the campers at the docks. One their way to Camp Cretaceous, the truck stops as their counselors Dave and Roxie try to wrangle an escaped Compsognathus that would later appear and startles Kenji and Ben, though the former tries to show off his bravery, the others (save Ben) laughed at him. Later at camp, the counselors tell them about the camp rules they must obey, and later Kenji and the other campers zip-line over a group of herbivorous dinosaurs.

Before going to bed, Kenji confronts Darius, who was sneaking away, boasting about his father's wealth and that he owns condos on the island. He tries to intimidate him, but Brooklynn's intrusion distracts him and together with her decide to join Darius in his efforts to infiltrate what he assumes to be the Compy pen. When they get there, Kenji and Brooklynn fight over her phone, causing it to fall inside the complex. Kenji tries to sneak into the compound to retrieve the phone, despite warnings from Darius. He is almost attacked by the raptor Blue, who is startled and agitated when he takes a photo with the phone's camera. As the raptor stalks him, Darius distracts Blue, while Brooklynn tries to open the door. Delta, Echo, and Charlie join Blue in cornering Darius and Kenji as the episode ends.

entities.name: Martin Krebs
entities.description:
Martin Krebs was a representative for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering who claimed that with the DNA of the world's largest dinosaurs, he can cure heart disease. He is one of the two main antagonists (alongside the Distortus rex) in .

In 2027, Martin Krebs is contacted by his employer Mr. Parker to retrieve blood samples from the three largest dinosaurs, which can cure heart disease. The creatures are located on an abandoned island, Ile Saint-Hubert, formerly owned by InGen. Due to its equatorial climate, which is similar to that of 60 million years ago, it's one of the few places on Earth where dinosaurs can survive by 2027.

Whilst driving in New York City, Krebs witnesses a sick and dying Apatosaurus in the streets. He stops his car and exits the vehicle and briefly looks at it while the authorities attempt to control the large herbivore. Krebs then gets back into his car, where he meets Zora Bennett, who Krebs has recruited for a top secret mission. They both discuss the mission as Bennett exits the vehicle.

Krebs parks the car and chases after Bennett, where Krebs informs Zora that the mission isn’t legal and that they are bringing a civilian to the mission. The two then go to a nearby museum where Dr. Henry Loomis, who is overseeing various artifacts of the museum’s collection being taken away due to low ticket sales, is working. Krebs tells Zora that Henry has been assisting Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering with research. The three of them discussed the mission with Henry not being sure if he should go, but Zora and Krebs are able to convince him. Loomis then says that they need blood samples from Quetzalcoatlus, Mosasaurus, and Titanosaurus to develop a drug called Paleodioxin that could cure heart disease.

entities.name: Vivian Krill
entities.description:
Vivian Krill was a Jurassic World employee. She worked in the control room, along with Lowery Cruthers. Seven years after the fall of Jurassic World, she was employed as a CIA agent.

Vivian Krill was working in the control room of Jurassic World before and partway through the incident. She monitored the park along with Lowery and was on good terms with him. When assets manager Claire Dearing asked her why the West Plains were closed, Vivian told her that it was due to another Pachycephalosaurus that had broken loose and, when Claire expressed annoyance at the failure of the invisible fences for the second time that month, Vivian explained that the dinosaurs shorted out their implants when they butted heads.

She was later talking to Lowery when they were called by Claire, who demanded the current coordinates of the Indominus rex. Lowery, confused, obeyed and they were both stunned and horrified to see that it was still in its paddock according to the implant and that there were people inside. Vivian frantically warned them to flee, but her warning came too late and she listened in horror as the Indominus killed and ate a worker and broke down the doors of the paddock. She attempted to alert the entire park about a dinosaur being on the loose, but was stopped by Simon Masrani, who believed the Asset Containment Unit could quietly contain the threat. Asset Containment proved ineffective and the majority of them were slaughtered by the creature. During Owen Grady's rant, Vivian exchanged a significant glance with Lowery before putting the park on alert on Claire's orders. She later went with Masrani as he prepared to pilot his personal helicopter, fitted with a heavy machine gun, to deal with the creature, despite her worried protestations.

Upon witnessing Masrani's death when his helicopter was attacked by Pteranodons, she reported the breach in the Aviary while crying in shock. When Vic Hoskins took control, she and Lowery stayed in the control room while the other personnel were "relieved of duty" by InGen. After Hoskins' plan of using Owen's Velociraptors to stop the Indominus failed, Vivian chooses to evacuate while Lowery decided to stay behind. When he attempted to kiss her, she awkwardly told him that she had a boyfriend, but gave him a hug before departing.

entities.name: LaFontaine
entities.description:
LaFontaine (French pronunciation: [lafɔ̃tɛn]) is a provincial electoral district in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, that elects members to the National Assembly of Quebec. It consists of  the neighbourhood of Rivière-des-Prairies in the borough of Rivière-des-Prairies–Pointe-aux-Trembles.

It was created for the 1966 election from a part of Bourget electoral district.

In the change from the 2001 to the 2011 electoral map, its territory was unchanged. From 1992 to 2001, the riding also included the northern half of Pointe-aux-Trembles.

It was named after the First Prime Minister of the United Province of Canada, Louis-Hippolyte Lafontaine.

entities.name: Lana Molina
entities.description:
Lana Molina was a supporting antagonist in the fifth season of Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous. Lana was a representative for Biosyn and was one of the investors who came to Mantah Corp Island to meet with Daniel Kon alongside Cyrus and Mr. Gold to see dino fights.

Molina, Cyrus, and Mr. Gold arrive on Mantah Corp Island and are greeted by Kon, When he apologizes for making them wear VR goggles on the flight to the island, Molina says she can think of more interesting ways to keep a secret, Kon then brings them to the compound. Molina asks Mr. Gold for his name, then gives him her card. Kon brings his son, Kenji to the party, they then hear Little Eatie roar, and Kon says he's just whetting their appetite for tomorrow, so they continue their conversation and listen to Kenji's stories of how he survived so many dinosaur encounters.

While walking to the Redwood forest for the presentation, Molina and Mr. Gold both get annoyed about how long its taking and request easier modes of transportation, Molina tells Kon that she can get her hands on some horses for him. Kash then arrives to join the presentation, so Kenji brings Molina and the other investors through the airlock while Kon talks to him. during the Presentation, Molina got to control the 2 Velociraptors. She caused them to fight against Big Eatie and the Spinosaurus. When the Nublar Six, minus Kenji, came to stop the dino fights, she uses them to kill them. As she continues her attack, Kash comes out and takes away the controller. This gave Sammy Gutierrez and Yasmina Fadoula the opportunity to disrupt the control chip in their heads and free them from the mind control. As Kash got the controller, he scared her off by threatening to turn the raptors on her but was really aiming for Kon. After the conflict, she called and told Kon that her buyer was interested in his tech and wanted to meet on Isla Nublar. She asks Kon what he is gonna do about the campers, reminding him to lock them up so they won't interfere until the deal is finished.

Molina accompanied Kon, Kenji, and Mae Turner to Isla Nublar and went to Kon's Penthouse. Kon asked Molina to do something but she cut him off and told him that since she doesn't work for him, she doesn't have to risk her life in the jungle. Molina stayed in the Penthouse while everyone else went to find a dinosaur to show off Kon's tech.

entities.description:
Kash D. Langford was the secondary antagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as an unseen antagonist of Seasons 1 and 3, the main antagonist of Season 4, and a supporting antagonist of Season 5.

He was the boss of Dr. Mae Turner at Mantah Corp, and the person who blackmailed Sammy Gutierrez's family into coming her to Jurassic World to spy and acquire InGen’s and Masrani Global's research and technology. He was known for his short temper.

Kash was a Caucasian man of moderately tall stature, sporting brown curly hair, blue eyes, and a nasal, slightly high-pitched voice. He wore a blue, short-sleeved shirt and black pants, a black earbud in his left ear, and a ring on his thumb, which he used to control the drones. His arms were adorned with various tattoos, the most prominent being a pond ecosystem on his left biceps. According to Mae, his tattoos were worse than his penchant for rock music.

Kash began working at Mantah Corp at some point in his life. Shortly before the Jurassic World Incident, he, under Daniel Kon's orders, threatened Sammy's family that they would lose their farm if Sammy didn't go to Jurassic World as a spy and collect samples. While her family refused, Sammy decides to go to save her family and to that, joins Camp Cretaceous as a spy.

entities.name: George Lawala
entities.description:
George Lawala was hired by Biosyn to bring them dinosaurs off of Isla Nublar. He chases Dr. Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler through a cave system before being attacked by a mother Raptor. He kills it, although it bites his leg while dying. Later, Lawala fights Alan and Ellie, ultimately capturing them, along with the mother's five adolescent raptors.

On board a cargo boat, Lawala finds both Alan and Ellie and the raptors trying to break out of their cages; he knocks them all out with knock-out gas before having them moved onto a cargo plane. Here, the Raptors escape and encircle Alan and Ellie's cage; they leave when they realize that they cannot enter the cage (as Alan’s earlier attempt to pick the lock has jammed it) and Lawala, investigating the weight shift in the plane, is attacked by a Raptor, whose head he promptly shoots apart. Lawala lets Alan and Ellie out and gives them guns so that the three can all search the plane; Lawala kills another attacking Raptor with a shot to the chest, before the plane's pilot, Brennan, appears; the pair are both attacked by a female Raptor (which shall later be named Celia), and although Lawala injures it, he and Brennan are both killed by her.

Later, in the comics, he is shown to have been Muldoon's both a friend and a rival in Africa. Muldoon feels indebted to Lawala because Lawala saved his life when he was attacked by a lion outside of a bar in Nairobi. Lawala's death urges Muldoon to avenge him by capturing the raptors, dead or alive.

entities.name: LeClerc
entities.description:
LeClerc was a mercenary who worked as a co-pilot and deckhand aboard the Essex. He and the rest of the crew were contracted by Martin Krebs to travel to Ile Saint-Hubert and collect DNA samples from the largest prehistoric species there in order to create a cure for heart disease. LeClerc is Haitian and primarily speaks French.

LeClerc co-piloted the Essex alongside Nina, whom he shared a close bond with. On their way to the Mosasaurus location, the ship picked up a mayday signal from Reuben Delgado. He and his family were stranded at sea after the Mosasaurus attacked their sailboat La Mariposa. After some debate, Kincaid decides that they would go to the provided coordinates to rescue them. Later on, LeClerc and Nina spot the overturned vessel from the upper pilothouse and Reuben fires a flare gun into the air. They steer the ship to where he is so that he, Isabella Delgado, Teresa Delgado, and Xavier Dobbs can all board it. After this, the team continues tracking the Mosasaurus.

During the encounter with the Mosasaurus to get DNA from it, LeClerc stayed inside the ship with Bobby Atwater and the Delgados. After the sample was successfully acquired, he congratulates Henry for his success.

The Mosasaurus would later return with a group of Spinosaurus to attack the Essex. Atwater tries fending off the Spinosaurs, but is surprise attacked by one and taken away. Duncan begins piloting the ship and tells LeClerc the engine is overheating. He goes down to the engine room to try quelling the heat. Now that the ship was close to shore, the Mosasaurus and its associates stopped pursuing it. LeClerc and Duncan were the only two who did not jump off before the boat crashed on the rocks of the island.

entities.name: Lee
entities.description:
Lee was an Asset Containment Unit trooper at Jurassic World on Isla Nublar in 2015.

During the Jurassic World Incident, Lee was part of a team consisting of himself, Katashi Hamada, Craig and Meyers. They were sent in, along with another team lead by Austin, to recapture the Indominus rex after it escaped containment and killed 2 workers.

Upon arriving at the hybrid's last recorded location, they discovered it had torn out its tracking-implant. While Hamada was inspecting the implant, the team was startled when the hybrid revealed it was camouflaging behind the trees and seized Hamada. The operatives managed to temporarily stun the animal, causing it to drop Hamada though inadvertently electrocuting him as well. However, they were unable to save Hamada, as he was crushed underfoot by the hybrid and killed instantly.

During the hybrid's ensuing assault on the group, Lee, Craig, Meyers and Cooper attempted to subdue the Indominus by using their cattle-prods and taser-rifles. However, their efforts failed when Craig and Cooper were killed by the hybrid. Austin proceeded to fire a net-launcher at the creature, briefly subduing it. However, in its struggles to tear the net off, it knocked over a tree, which crushed a fleeing Lee and killed him.

entities.name: Leon
entities.description:
Leon was a worker at the Raptor Research Arena.

Leon was new, having replaced another worker who'd either been injured or killed while tending to the animals. He was on duty when Vic Hoskins was watching Owen Grady working with his Velociraptors. When a pig used to feed the raptors got loose inside the pen, Leon attempted to use a noose on the end of a long pole to retrieve the animal before the raptors ate it. He was too late. Although he got the noose around the pig's neck, Echo snatched the pig and jerked it away. Leon, holding onto the pole, got pulled off of the elevated walkway he was standing on and fell into the enclosure with the animals.

He was immediately surrounded by Blue, Delta, and Charlie, who hissed and snarled fiercely at him. As he scooted away from them, Owen opened the door and entered the paddock, and was able to successfully make the four raptors back down, allowing Leon to make it safely out of the enclosure before leaving, Owen warned Leon to be more careful next time. As he sat with his back to the bars of the enclosure, Leon was asked if he was "the new guy" and whether he was aware of his predecessor's fate, which he didn't seem to be. Owen then told him he shouldn't sit with his back to the cage, and turning, Leon was startled as Echo hissed at him through the bars.

Later, when Owen plays the "Hide-And-Seek" with the raptors to track down the Indominus rex, he was seen opening the cage gate.

entities.name: Alice Levin
entities.description:
Alice Levin was Richard Stone's lab assistant.

Alice is basically a technician. She kept insisting that the unidentified Procompsognathus remains that were sent to their lab, were remains of a dinosaur. She claimed to be an expert on dinosaurs because she was the mother of two boys, who loved dinosaurs. However, she said that the smallest dinosaur was called a "teenysaurus or something", proving that she really did not know a lot about dinosaurs. Dr. Stone kept dismissing her claim that the remains were of a dinosaur and recalled a time when Alice insisted that she was being stalked by one of the surgical orderlies. Alice eventually sent an X-ray of the Procompsognathus remains to Alan Grant, for confirmation of her theory. Grant was shocked to discover that the remains were of a Procompsognathus. Donald Gennaro later requested that the remains be sent to Isla Nublar, to determine whether or not the animal was one of InGen's.

entities.name: Richard Levine
entities.description:
Dr. Richard Levine is a wealthy paleontologist who appears only in . Like John Hammond, he is only interested in details, particularly the behavior of dinosaurs and does not much think of the consequences of his actions nor how the dinosaurs on Isla Sorna were created. In this way, he acts as the antithesis of Ian Malcolm, who shows interest in the cause and effect aspect of actions. The Lost World starts with a series of appearances of large and unknown lizards being found on the shores of Costa Rica. Levine and Martin Gutierrez travel to Costa Rica to investigate these appearances. Levine attempts to take pictures of a body of a large dinosaur carcass, identified as an Ornitholestes. Levine sends some of its flesh to Dr. Malcolm who inspects it with his friend Elizabeth Gelman.

During the events of he is in his early thirties. He is tall and dark. He often wears khaki clothing. He wears wire-frame spectacles and was known to be often cowardly towards the worst of situations.

He is precise in his movements and manner. He is generally agreed to be the best (and most irritating) paleontologist of his generation. Most people find him pompous and arrogant. He ignores his own plight, ignoring dangers to his own health, even after being bitten by a Procompsognathus, and was never grateful for being rescued. He thinks incredibly high of himself and very lowly of his peers, thinking of field work as mostly “poking around in animal crap”. Only after Ian Malcolm and Sarah Harding explain the effects of DX and him realizing he was bitten by a compy, does Levine realize he may suffer from adverse health effects.

Richard Levine was probably born in the early 1960s, since he is in his early thirties in 1993. Levine is part of the Estate of a famous toy series, the Becky Dolls. Though precise details remain unknown "Becky Dolls" could very well likely be a pseudonym for the "Pleasant Company" makers of requisite and quality dolls in the 1990s. The company is now called "American Girl" and remains successful throughout the decades, insinuating that therefore he is wealthy. The Becky Dolls could also be a pseudonym for "Barbie Dolls."

entities.name: Limbo
entities.description:
Limbo was a male Baryonyx, and a supporting antagonist of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as one of the three tertiary antagonists of season 2, a minor character in Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure and season 3, and a supporting antagonist in season 5. Limbo has two other companions, Chaos and Grim, who are presumably his siblings.

Limbo is a Baryonyx comprised of brown and dark yellow complexion, he is the only known Baryonyx to have this sort of coloration.

Limbo cares deeply for his companions, tracking down Grim when she had been separated from Limbo and Chaos and both of the latter tracking down and killing Tiff when she killed Grim. The pack didn't always get along however, and Limbo would occasionally squabble with Chaos in the middle of hunts. Limbo was seemingly easily distracted as well, as he chose to hunt some people they encountered over helping Chaos' attempts to free Grim.

Limbo was one of the Baryonyx kept at Jurassic World, where he formed a close bond with other members of his species Chaos and Grim. At some point Grim was taken to a medical center on the island, eventually being abandoned there when the Jurassic World Incident forced the island to be abandoned.

entities.name: Little Eatie
entities.description:
Little Eatie is a female Tyrannosaurus rex, and a supporting character in the fourth and and a major character in the fifth season of the animated series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous.

Like every female Tyrannosaur in the franchise, but unlike her mother, Little Eatie's skin is brown in color, and she sports black-gray stripes that goes along the dorsal region of her body, and down her arms and legs. Little Eatie also sports old scars of unknown origins, most likely from her and Big Eatie's previous play-fightings, and gain fresh new scars from her and her mother's fight after they eat the tainted meats orchestrated by Mantah Corp; however, these scars have now healed by the start of Season 5.

Little Eatie, a sub-adult Tyrannosaurus rex, has grown to nearly match her mother's size, indicating she's in her mid to late adolescence. Despite her increased size and strength, she still exhibits a strong dependence on her mother, particularly in situations involving potential threats.

During encounters with formidable predators like the Spinosaurus, Toro, Baryonyx, and Dimorphodon, Little Eatie displays a mix of fear and aggression, suggesting she is still refining her threat assessment and response strategies. Her mother's presence and guidance play a crucial role in her defense, as she relies on her mother's experience and protection to ensure her safety.

entities.name: Benjamin Lockwood
entities.description:
Sir Benjamin Lockwood was a billionaire philanthropist, the head of the Lockwood Family fortune, and the former longtime friend and business partner of John Hammond. Together with Hammond, Lockwood created InGen and thus funded the creation of the technology that allowed for the cloning of dinosaurs and the resulting locations of Jurassic Park and Site B. In his later life he sought redemption in attempting to save the remaining Isla Nublar dinosaurs from the Eruption of Mt. Sibo. However his efforts were usurped by Eli Mills who would later murder him in order to control his estate.

Benjamin was the father of Charlotte Lockwood and the grandfather of Maisie Lockwood.

Sir Benjamin Lockwood was the Master of Lockwood Manor. At an unknown point, he married an unknown woman and had a daughter Charlotte Lockwood. Charlotte was raised by Benjamin and his housekeeper Iris at the manor. Like her father, Charlotte had a great love for dinosaurs.

Lockwood was business partners with Scottish businessman and billionaire John Hammond. The two were good friends and they shared a dream of bringing back dinosaurs from extinction. In order to pursue this dream, Lockwood and Hammond used their respective fortunes and built a laboratory in the subbasement of Lockwood's manor. They hired geneticist Dr. Henry Wu to aid them in the genetics work. They succeeded in 1986 and together (at some point) founded InGen, a genetics company whose goal was to continue development of cloning dinosaurs. In 1982, they acquired Isla Sorna where the dinosaurs were bred.

entities.name: Maisie Lockwood
entities.description:
Maisie Lockwood is the cloned daughter of the late Charlotte Lockwood, the granddaughter of the late Benjamin Lockwood, and the adoptive daughter of Owen Grady and Claire Dearing. Maisie was raised for much of her life at Lockwood Manor before the Dinosaur Outbreak and her subsequent adoption by Owen and Claire.

Maisie is a major character and portrayed by Isabella Sermon, serving as the tritagonist in and the deuteragonist in .

Maisie was born in 2008, which means she was born 10 years before the events of Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. She was created by Charlotte Lockwood from her own DNA and carried to term like a normal pregnancy, only without the use of a father. Charlotte was a gifted geneticist and the daughter of InGen, and Jurassic Park founder, Benjamin Lockwood, growing up around the technology to clone the DNA of extinct animals. She created Maisie by building upon her grandfather's technology and the work of Henry Wu and had succeeded.

Sometime after Maisie's birth, Charlotte had contracted a genetic disease that would also affect Maisie. But with her experience as a geneticist, she managed to not only create a cure for the disease, but completely eradicate it from Maisie's body. But sadly this was not able to save Charlotte's life.

entities.name: Cheryl Logan
entities.description:
Cheryl Logan was one of Alan Grant's graduate students at the Fort Peck Lake dig site during .

The Jurassic Park III film script reveals more of Cheryl:We see CHERYL, 21, a junior at junior of State. She's one of a dozen COLLEGE STUDENTS working at the site, and the one most smitten with her supervisor (Billy Brennan).She asked Billy to better tell the difference between a rock and a fossil. He runs her bare fingers over the two different patches, showing her that rock is rough and fossil is smooth.

In the script the two start to flirt. Cheryl runs her finger along his stubbly chin, "rough", and along his lips, "smooth". Billy may not have started this flirtation, but he's not ending it either.

The two stop talking when Dr. Grant arrives at the site.

entities.name: Henry Loomis
entities.description:
Dr. Henry Loomis is a paleontologist and principal character in . The character, per director Gareth Edwards, is "very comfortable on digs and expeditions but not the life-and-death risks" and is “out of his depth in terms of the military element of the mission".

Prior to 2027, Dr. Loomis conducted his postdoctoral research under the supervision of Dr. Alan Grant.

By 2027, Dr. Loomis worked at a museum in New York that was closing due to a loss of public interest in dinosaurs, which were dying off because the modern climate of Earth was becoming inhospitable to them. For the past six months, Dr. Loomis had been advising Parker-Genix on paleo-coronary health for developing a drug that could cure heart disease with the DNA of three selected dinosaurs. Zora Bennett and Martin Krebs, the representative of Parker-Genix, summoned Dr. Loomis to join a team to collect blood samples from the selected creatures - Titanosaurus, Mosasaurus and Quetzalcoatlus - on Ile Saint-Hubert. This island is located near French Guiana in the equatorial region, where the climate is suitable for dinosaurs.

While tracking the Mosasaurus to collect its DNA sample, Dr. Loomis observed the Spinosaurus and the Mosasaurus hunting together, displaying mutualism. When he saw the Titanosaurus, he got close to the legs of one of them and touched it. He had never seen a dinosaur in its natural habitat before, only in a theme park or wandering around cities.

entities.name: Raul Lopez
entities.description:
A well-known paleontologist with supposedly “radical theories”, Raul Lopez, along with Sonya Durant, was hired by BioSyn to investigate Isla Nublar and its strange occurrences. Raul appears only in the Jurassic Park comics. He is featured in the Return to Jurassic Park series.

Raul Lopez and Sonya Durant encounter Drs. Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler, Robert Muldoon and Edgar Prather on the island, and after a quick argument, the group are attacked by Cearadactyls. Unarmed, Raul cannot fend off the creatures, so Ellie passes him her gun. After the attack, Raul and Sonya prepare to take the InGen team hostage, but the army attacks and another fight breaks out. The two teams decide to merge temporarily. Shortly afterwards, they are attacked by the island’s Tyrannosaurus, but Alan fends it off. Later, Raul and Muldoon discuss the paleontologist's theories. At night, the group sails across a river in two boats; the Rex attacks them, but they are able to escape. They eventually come across the army base; while Edgar and Sonya go ahead to enter, Alan, Ellie, Muldoon and Raul are captured. While Alan, Ellie and Muldoon talk amongst themselves, Raul stays silent, and when Edgar comes to rescue them, he snaps Raul’s neck, killing him.

entities.name: M. Akiyama
entities.description:
Makio Akiyama (秋山 万喜夫, Akiyama Makio; born 1950) is a Japanese astronomer affiliated with the Susono Observatory (886). He is a discoverer of minor planets, credited by the Minor Planet Center with the discovery of 16 numbered minor planets during 1989–1999.

In 1992 he discovered the asteroid 6251 Setsuko in collaboration with astronomer Toshimasa Furuta, and named it after his wife Setsuko Akiyama (born 1953) in May 1996 (M.P.C. 27129).

The main-belt asteroid 4904 Makio, discovered by Yoshikane Mizuno and Toshimasa Furuta at Kani Observatory (403) in 1989, is named after him. Naming citation was published on 5 March 1996 (M.P.C. 26763).

entities.name: M142
entities.description:
M142 was the tracking tag given to the Mosasaurus in .

M142 has more than 100 vertebrae for flexibility while swimming. Its mouth is long and has two rows of teeth on its upper jaw with a bite force of up to 16,000 pounds per square inch, enough to crush whale bones. Unlike the Nublar variant, its skin is relatively smooth, but its spine is lined with bumps along its length. The body surface is brown mixed with yellow-green and has black-brown patterns. The belly is white and has deep grooves along its length, similar to those found in baleen whales, helps the body resist water currents. Its tail is broad and paddle-shaped, with a triangular fin at the base that gives it immense power to propel its large body while swimming for 20 km/hr.

At one point around 2005, InGen built a research center on Ile Saint-Hubert. In 2010, an accident occurred and left the island deserted, and the experimental animals were released, including one Mosasaurus tagged "M142." The Mosasaurus had claimed the sea around the island as its territory for almost 20 years, despite the lack of a fence keeping it contained. In that time, it developed a symbiotic relationship with the Spinosaurus pack to enhance its hunting and territorial defense capabilities.

After living for 17 years, the Mosasaurus had grown to just over 30 meters in length. InGen still had its tracker with the tag ‘M142’ for a while before going bankrupt after Jurassic world went down. Big Pharma company Parker-Genix bought InGen's information and now tracks it. They plan to collect samples from it along with two other large animals on the island, Titanosaurus and Quetzalcoatlus. Company representative Martin hired Duncan's team and come to the island on the Essex.

entities.name: Major
entities.description:
Major is a male Majungasaurus featured in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory, serving as a secondary antagonist during Season 2.

Major is one of the dinosaurs that is to be smuggled on Captain Lang's ship and brought to The Broker. In the hustle caused by the Nublar Six when the ship departs, however, Major is accidentally spun into a container with another conspecific. The second Majungasaurus is then killed and partially eaten by Major due to the cannibalistic nature of the species, and the events can be heard while Kenji Kon is trying to smuggle snacks to the other stowaways.

Later during the storm, Major's container breaks open, causing the Majungasaurus to sneak around aboard the ship and kill a free-roaming Gallimimus, as well as other dinosaurs. After a daring action, however, Darius manages to lure Major back into his container without causing any further deaths.

When Yaz roams alone through the African jungle at night, she is threatened by a single lion, but it is killed by Major in an ambush. The Majungasaurus then chases Yaz to a riverbank, where Yaz is reunited with the rest of the Nublar Six.

entities.name: Makena
entities.description:
Makena was a male assistant to Sarah Harding in Tanzania.

He was introduced as he asked her if the jeep they were on were close enough to the hyena pack and she told him their position was fine. He needed to be reminded once when her phone rang and he let it ring three times before he answered and learnt it was Doc Thorne calling. Makena helped Harding to head to twon to catch a flight to Costa Rica. He is definitely Eastern African as he answered the call saying 'Jambo' which sort of means 'hello' in English.

entities.name: Kelly Malcolm
entities.description:
Kelly Curtis Malcolm is the daughter of Ian Malcolm and an unnamed woman; during The Lost World: Jurassic Park. She is first mentioned indirectly alongside two other siblings in Jurassic Park as Ian briefly mentions he has three kids.

Kelly first appears when she greets her father, Dr. Ian Malcolm, when he is visiting Eddie Carr in his garage where Eddie is modifying the vehicles that are to be used in their expedition to Isla Sorna. Although she insists on accompanying Malcolm on his journey, the destination of which he withholds from her, Malcolm is adamant that Kelly stays with an associate by the name of Karen. After a short argument where Kelly remarks her cut from the school gymnastics team and her feelings on Malcolm often not paying attention to her, Malcolm reports to Eddie, but not before he sarcastically tells Kelly not to listen to him. While Malcolm is conversing with Eddie, Kelly sneaks aboard the trailers and stows away. Stowing herself inside of a storage compartment.

Once on Isla Sorna, Kelly takes the time to make dinner for the rest of the group who are at this point unaware of her presence. However, her campfire alerts the attention of Eddie Carr and Nick Van Owen, the team's video documentarian, who rush to put it with a jug of water before being told to switch to dirt by Dr. Sarah Harding. It is here that Kelly reveals herself and her good-hearted intent to the group. Malcolm is infuriated that Kelly has followed him to Isla Sorna, and after having her clean up the mess she made of the trailer when she was cooking, she points out the sound of approaching helicopters.

Following the rest of the documentation team, Kelly joins the group in watching Peter Ludlow's InGen Harvest Operation chase down and capture several dinosaurs on a Game Trail. Later that evening, she continues to follow as the team track down the InGen Encampment, where she asks why InGen would want to build another Park on Isla Sorna after what Ian told her happened to the Isla Nublar park. Malcolm responds that the InGen team isn't building a Park here, they're taking the dinosaurs off the island. It is here that Nick Van Owen reveals his alternate purpose on the team as a saboteur in the event that Ludlow's team were to arrive. As Nick and Sarah sneak in and sabotage the InGen encampment, Ian and Kelly return to the trailers and Eddie goes to the High Hide.

entities.name: Male Alpha Velociraptor
entities.description:
Unlike the lowland Velociraptor, the highland Velociraptor vocalized and trapped more in hunting. Their traps were rather complex, an example of this being when a male stalked the rescue team for Eric Kirby throughout the InGen Compound and putting its head inside one of the empty tanks, pretending to be one of the dinosaur fetuses found in the laboratory waiting for one of the members of the rescue team to encounter him. Another example is when the previously mentioned male pinned down rescue team member Udesky to draw out his fellow teammates that were seeking refuge high in a tree.

From the only pack observed, they were highly respectful of each other, especially their leader. Aggression among packmates, such as to usurp the leader, is relatively unknown in this variant with no observations of this behavior. However, when one male individual threatened to attack the rescue team, the Alpha roared at said pack mate, commanding it to stand down.

Their nests were created close to other nests of their kind. Whether these groups of nests all belonged to more or just one pack is unknown. When one or more eggs were taken from the nest, the pack who owned that nest would relentlessly pursue whoever stole their eggs.

In the genetics admissions lab, the male is seen hiding its head behind one of the incubator machines, which are holding some embryos. As Amanda Kirby takes a closer look, its eye moves and he lunges out from behind the glass. He tries to bite Amanda but is too big to fit through the machines. The raptor finds another way and chases the survivors, eventually trapping them in a maze of dinosaur cages. Billy Brennan and Amanda trapped the raptor in one of the cages and it lets out a screeching, birdlike call. Dr. Alan Grant is amazed by it calling for help. Eventually, the alpha male gets out and calls to its packmates. In the jungle, other raptors him from the building and answer back. During the stampede of Parasaurolophus and Corythosaurus, two males are seen running at speeds up to 50-60 mph. In the jungle, a female stabs its retractable claw in Udesky's back and the pack uses him as bait to lure Billy, Amanda, and Paul Kirby. The raptors again make another play on human emotions when it comes to compassion. When the trap fails, the male raptor kills Udesky by snapping his neck.

entities.name: Male Tyrannosaur
entities.description:
Baby Tyrannosaur (baby) Other babies|born=Before 1989}}The male Tyrannosaurus was a Tyrannosaurus rex individual cloned by InGen on Isla Sorna. The T. rex was left there to fend for itself after the 1989 incident. The Tyrannosaur did well in the wild and found a mate.

Created on Isla Sorna sometime during the mid to late '80s, the male and female Tyrannosaur would be bred and raised there until InGen would leave the island post the 1989 incident. It is unknown whether any other tyrannosaurs were housed on Sorna. However, during the six year timespan between the two novels the rexes would pair and have at least one successful brood.

After receiving Richard Levine's coordinates, Jack Thorne took a motorcycle to the T. rex nest. When Jack found Levine, Levine accidentally fell from the tree he was in. His fall made too much noise which alerted the tyrannosaur parents which were feeding their young, leading to the male to chase them away.

Later, the team of Biosyn agents lead by Dr. Lewis Dodgson tried to steal the eggs of Tyrannosaurs. The attempt fails, resulting in George Baselton being eaten, Howard King breaking the leg of one of the babies, and their jeep being pushed stuck in thick undergrowth. King and Dodgson were both rendered unconscious from the raid. Afterward, Eddie, believing that the juvenile could be healed and returned, secretly brought it back to the trailer.

Mariana is a Hispanic-American mother of a mixed family from Oakland, California. Mariana was portrayed by American actress Natalie Martinez in the short film Battle at Big Rock.

Mariana is from Oakland, California. A Hispanic American, Mariana was once in a relationship with an unknown (possibly also Hispanic) man with whom she had a son, Mateo. Under unknown circumstances, Mariana separated from Mateo's father and became a single mother. Sometime before 2017, Mariana would meet Dennis, an African-American man who was also from Oakland and the father of Kadasha. Mariana and Dennis would form a relationship and in 2017 marry and bring their families together as one. Sometime later in either 2018 or 2019, Mariana would give birth to Dennis' unnamed son, the younger half brother of Mateo and Kadasha.

Mariana and her family embarked on a camping trip to Big Rock National Park in Northern California. They would stay at a camp ground with other campers in trailers. Mariana had attended to setting up the table for her family while her husband grilled chicken outside. When everyone sat down to eat, Kadasha and Mateo began arguing with each other leading Mariana to gently reprimand her children. She reminded them that they were now a family and needed to look out for and protect one another.

Simon Masrani was the CEO of the Masrani Global Corporation and founder of two of its subsidiaries, Jurassic World and Masrani Energy.

Simon Masrani was born to Sanjay Masrani, founder of the Masrani Global Corporation along with its first subsidiary Mascom, and an unknown mother in Bombay (now Mumbai), India, 1967.

When his father passed in 1992, the corporation was passed down to Simon. He expanded Mascom's services beyond just satellite television and into weather and telecommunications. Though what put Masrani Global Corporation into recognition was the foundation of Masrani Oil (now Masrani Energy) in Abu Dhabi in 1996, which despite being the youngest oil company in the world it generated the third largest income for any company from 1997-2004.

entities.name: Mateo
entities.description:
Mateo is a supporting character in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. He is a Filipino-American Department of Prehistoric Wildlife truck driver who resigned from his job after accidentally getting Brooklynn seemingly killed.

Mateo worked as a truck driver from DPW transporting dinosaurs. During his job, a stranger told him on the phone that he could earn money in exchange for transporting dinosaurs and unloading them into another truck. Although he was getting money, Mateo hoped against hope that he wouldn't be doing any harm and desired to save up enough money for his daughter Hiraya to go to college.

When he arrived one night with an Allosaurus, he was alone with no other trucks. He found it strange and even more so when he noticed that the dinosaur he was transporting was not sedated and the lock opened on its own, freeing it. He hid in some bushes to avoid it, until the Allosaurus left upon hearing something. Mateo witnessed the dinosaur chasing Brooklynn while he was still hiding, being very shocked and scared that it was happening. As he left, he noticed blood on the road, which made him believe that the Allosaurus had killed the young woman, finding her phone ringing, just as Darius Bowman arrived. Mateo panicked and felt remorseful when he saw that he had won more money for the young woman's death.

He remained in the DPW for some time, but eventually decided to give up, feeling guilt stricken about what had happened. He set out to do the right thing and redeem himself, trying to locate the Nublar Six, and although it took him a long time, because he was not very good with the internet, he eventually found them with help from his daughter Hiraya.

entities.name: McNally
entities.description:
McNally was a poacher tracking Blue in Gibson Peak, California following the Dinosaur Outbreak. He and his partner, Jones sought to bag the raptor following it's disruption of ranching operations in the area.

McNally and his partner Jones were hired by local ranchers in the Gibson Peak area to deal with the raptor, Blue who had been killing livestock and destroying property. They were expected to have completed the job by friday. While in the woods they were observed by Maisie Lockwood and Violet Moody who overheard them discussing their plans. McNally convinced Jones to without their bosses knowledge kill the two Triceratops they sighted earlier and sell their horns on the market as well as bag Blue for him and the ranchers. Following this agreement they went back to their motel for an equipment check then head out the following morning.

Coming back the next day they were attacked by Maisie from a treehouse. McNally in response ordered Jones to pursue the Triceratops calls they heard while he pursued Maisie. Using a climbing axe and spiked boots to reach the top he attempted to grab Maisie as she swung off a rope to the ground however only succeeded in severing the rope, trapping him in the treehouse. He was later taken into custody by Sheriff Wragg and his deputies.

Throughout the book there are several hints that Jones and McNally work for a larger organization rather than being independent poachers. During their first conversation they mention a "facility" and a "boss" who is interested in capturing Blue. They're also well aware of Owen, Claire and Maisie's identities, Jones even going so far as to taunt them about it. The organization they work for is unknown but due to the interest in Blue and Maisie one could reasonably assume they work for Biosyn. This tracks due to Lewis Dodgson having several ties to poaching and the black market. This mercenary was one of Eli Mills' mercenaries. He was sent with Ken Wheatley to help gather up the dinosaurs on Isla Nublar when Mount Sibo became active again. During the eruption he was seen ordering his fellow mercenaries to get on the boat as the volcano began to erupt. Seeing the last of the men on the boat the mercenary quickly made his escape onto the boat himself. entities.name: Meyers
entities.description:
Meyers was an Asset Containment Unit trooper at Jurassic World on Isla Nublar during the 2015 Isla Nublar Incident. She is one of only two named survivors of the ACU teams which attempted to subdue the Indominus rex, the other being Austin, although a few more troopers escaped with them.

Meyers was the sole female member of the Asset Containment Unit team that was dispatched to recapture the Indominus rex, personally handing a shock prod to Commander Katashi Hamada.

After arriving at the asset's last recorded location, she watched as Hamada inspected the creature's tracking implant, which she had clawed out, and was startled when the animal emerged from the foliage with camouflaged scales. She and her teammates shot the Indominus with stunners, making it drop Hamada though accidentally electrocuting him as well, but they failed to save him as he was crushed under its foot.

During the Indominus ensuing attack, Meyers, Craig and Lee attempted to subdue the creature with their taser prods and rifles, but they only made it disoriented and, though her two teammates were killed, Meyers managed to avoid suffering a similar fate. When the creature managed to free itself from the net that Austin had fired at it, Meyers and another trooper attempted to strike it from behind but were thrown back into the foliage after it struck them with its tail. After it killed and devoured Spears, the remaining ACU unit lost all hope of capturing the creature and scattered in terror, with Meyers running through the jungle away from the infuriated dinosaur.

entities.name: Eli Mills
entities.description:
Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous (mentioned)

Elijah "Eli" Mills was a major antagonist of the Jurassic Park franchise, serving as the main antagonist of , one of the two unseen overarching antagonists of Season 3 of the Netflix spin-off Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, and a posthumous antagonist of .

Mills was a businessman who was in charge of the Lockwood Estate's fortune on behalf of Benjamin Lockwood. Mills secretly sought to save the dinosaurs from Isla Nublar; in order to sell them to the highest bidders and also backed the creation of the Indoraptor, a weaponized prototype hybrid dinosaur that Mills believed to be the start of further dinosaur weapons. However, his plans were thwarted by members of the Dinosaur Protection Group; who had freed the dinosaurs and Mills himself was later killed and eaten by Rexy and a Carnotaurus.

Mills was shown to be a businessman, who above all else, was accepting of his actions as being evil. Instead of justifying his actions by claiming he was morally good, Mills openly expressed and acknowledged his actions to be considered evil. Befitting a sociopath, Mills uses other people's past mistakes or faults to absolve himself of any responsibility for his actions; such as when he pointed out Claire and Owen's actions in the 2015 incident inadvertently endangered others, not recognizing their more moral intentions compared to his evil intentions. Before he was about to murder Lockwood, he even stated he was guilty like him for his mistakes with cloning, again refusing to acknowledge his victims' better intentions. But his own actions are so poorly thought out that he pretty much embodies everything he claims to hate.

entities.name: Mitch Wyley
entities.description:
Mitchell "Mitch" Wyley was the husband of Tiff Wyley, and a major antagonist of Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, serving as the secondary antagonist of Season 2 and a posthumous antagonist of the following seasons.

Mitch was a Caucasian man presumably in his 30's. He was of tall stature sporting golden hair and green eyes. His clothing attire consisted of a blue, unbuttoned shirt, fedora and trilobite worn around the neck.

Mitch publicly presents himself as an amenable wildlife photographer and outdoors enthusiast, dressing in 20th century safari garb. He isn't an unintelligent man, genuinely knowing some knowledge in the field of paleontology enough to impress Darius Bowman, whom he formed a small bond with due to this common trait. In private however, he is a amoral and deluded sports hunter.

Unlike previous big game hunters such as Roland Tembo and Ajay Sidhu, he seems far less interested in the challenge of the hunt than he is at obtaining trophies (like the prepared head of a Sinoceratops) to decorate his "man cave". The only individual he shows any concern for is his wife Tiff, and even then, the two squabble frequently and seem to have a strained relationship. However, despite revealing his colors, Mitch remains amicable to the kids especially Darius who he nicknames "D".

entities.name: Karen Mitchell
entities.description:
Karen Mitchell (née Dearing) is the mother of Zach and Gray, the wife of Scott and the older sister of Claire Dearing.

In 2015, Karen felt it was a good idea to send Zach and Gray to spend some time with their Aunt Claire, who they barely knew and decided to send them on a vacation to Jurassic World. However, the vacation was simply a front so Karen and Scott could finish filing their divorce papers without their sons interfering. Karen saw Zach and Gray off at the airport, where she narrowly avoided another argument with her husband due to his negativity and pessimism, and jokingly reminded them to run if something chased them, not knowing how useful this information would be to them during their visit.

Sometime during the vacation, Karen dismissed herself from a business meeting to check-up on Claire and see how she and the boys were doing. But she was disappointed at the fact that Claire was putting them off to work and quickly began sobbing at the fact her entire family was drifting apart, noting Zach and Gray’s sibling rivalry. At the end of their phone call, Claire vowed to take the following day off to spend with her nephews.

Karen and Scott reached Jurassic World by the morning after the incident had ended and worriedly searched the droves of wounded people for their family members. Karen rejoiced when she saw her children and sister alive and well, where she embraced them.

entities.name: Zach Mitchell
entities.description:
Zachary "Zach" Mitchell is a teenage boy who was present in the incident at Jurassic World, with his younger brother, Gray. He is the older son of Karen and Scott, as well as the older nephew of Claire Dearing.

Zach appears in the novel, The Evolution of Claire, as a toddler. He plays no major role in the book.

Zach was talking to his girlfriend about how he should send texts so that she doesn't "forget" him. After that, he entered into the car with his and Gray's mother and father, preparing to go to a local airport to go to Jurassic World.

After boarding an airplane, Gray and Zach boarded a ferry boat to Masrani Global Corporation's famous dinosaur theme park Jurassic World, whose aunt, Claire Dearing, was Senior Assets Manager for. They were supervised by Claire's personal assistant Zara, as Claire was too busy to spend time with her nephews. While there, they got to see many of Jurassic World's attractions, including the Mosasaurus Feeding Show, Underwater Observatory, and the T. rex Kingdom, with Zach showing some interest in the former event. On the way, in the Monorail, Zach told his brother to stop crying and grow up, seeing as how Gray was in tears after hearing that their parents are getting divorced.

entities.name: Mo
entities.description:
Mo is the owner of Mo's Gas Diesel in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory. He is portrayed by actor Brock Powell.

A young Nasutoceratops settles in front of Mo's Gas Diesel, so he calls the Department of Prehistoric Wildlife. While waiting for the DPW to arrive, Ben and Darius arrive to fill Ben's van's fuel tank. While the two are there, the Nasutoceratops gets one of its horns stuck between two poles. With the help of Ben and Darius, the dinosaur is freed, and it reunites with its relatives. Mo thanks the young men and gives them supplies for the rest of their journey.
